target.name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

scope.goal: Define requirements for a C2 JU to publish Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance tracks on the Link 16 network, including message selection, reporting responsibility (R2), correlation/decorrelation, data content, track quality, and termination procedures.
scope.start_boundary: When a C2 JU detects, initiates, or prepares to publish an Air or Surface (Maritime) track, achieves Active status, or receives remote data requiring correlation/response.
scope.success_boundary: Eligible Air or Surface tracks are published only by the C2 JU with reporting responsibility using J3.2/J3.3 messages and required common-tracking, correlation, content, nonreal-time, termination, and startup procedures.
in_scope: Transmission of J3.2 Air Track and J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track messages in Network PGs
Reporting Responsibility (R2) acquisition, retention, and relinquishment for Air/Surface tracks
Common tracking, correlation, decorrelation, and dual-designation resolution for Air and Surface tracks
Track reporting criteria (completeness, accuracy, timeliness)
Positional data, velocity, altitude, identity, strength, IFF/SIF, and track quality reporting
Integration of PPLI reports with surveillance data
Termination of tracks (Drop Track, Purging)
Minimum wait times before transmitting tracks
Handling of simulated tracks
out_of_scope: Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance (J3.4)
Land (Ground) surveillance (J3.5) except where rules are shared
Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance (J3.6)
Electronic Warfare surveillance (J3.7)
NonC2 JU transmission rules
Detailed message bit-level encoding not specified in text
Link 11/11B or ATDL-1 specific protocols beyond J7.4 identifier management

evidence.quote: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.
b. Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance data included in the J3.2 Air Track message and the J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track message.
The specific messages used to report Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) surveillance data are the J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI = 1) messages, respectively.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall use J3.2 for Air and J3.3 for Surface (Maritime) surveillance data, and shall transmit an Air or Surface track only when it has R2.

evidence.quote: The specific messages used to report Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) surveillance data are the J3.2, J3.3, and J3.5 (PTI = 1) messages, respectively.
A JU transmits a track report for an Air, Surface (Maritime) or Land (Ground) track only when it has R2 for that track.

requirements.text: A C2 JU participating in J3 Surveillance exchange shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall ensure track information is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.
requirements.conditions: When reporting surveillance track information on the interface

evidence.quote: The information on the track is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall correlate data and minimize dual designation.
requirements.conditions: When reporting surveillance track information on the interface

evidence.quote: Data are correlated and dual designation is minimized.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall follow proper track-reporting rules.
requirements.conditions: When reporting surveillance track information on the interface

evidence.quote: The proper rules for reporting a track are followed.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall provide the source of track data in Source TN.

evidence.quote: The source of track data shall be provided (Source TN).

requirements.text: A C2 JU capable of automatically initiating tracks without operator action shall provide a capability to deactivate that automatic initiation.
requirements.conditions: If the C2 JU has the capability to automatically initiate tracks for release to the interface without operator action

evidence.quote: C2 JUs that have the capability to automatically initiate tracks for release to the interface without operator action shall also have the capability to deactivate this automatic capability.

requirements.text: A C2 JU reporting a real-time track shall report position extrapolated to transmission time.
requirements.conditions: When reporting a real-time track

evidence.quote: A JU reporting a real-time track shall report the position of the track extrapolated to the time of transmission.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall identify nonreal-time data and provide time tags.

evidence.quote: Nonreal-time data shall be identified as such and time tags shall be provided.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not extrapolate nonreal-time track positions.

evidence.quote: Nonreal-time track positions shall not be extrapolated.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall perform common tracking by sharing a common TN and shifting R2, normally with one C2 JU reporting while others withhold.

evidence.quote: Each air, surface (maritime), land (ground), and space tracked object normally will be reported by one C2 JU while other C2 JUs withhold their reports to prevent cluttering the tactical plot.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall determine the responsible reporting C2 JU according to Air and Surface Surveillance procedures.

evidence.quote: Determination of the C2 JU responsible for reporting the tracked object shall be in accordance with the procedures in the Air, Surface, Land, and Space Surveillance sections.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall correlate and decorrelate local track data with remote data received.

evidence.quote: all C2 JUs shall perform correlation and decorrelation of their local track data with respect to the remote data which they are receiving.

requirements.text: Each C2 JU capable of originating real-time Air or Surface tracks shall be capable of common tracking under the stated procedures.
requirements.conditions: If the C2 JU has a capability to originate and report real-time air, surface (maritime), land (ground), or space tracks

evidence.quote: Each C2 JU which has a capability to originate and report real-time air, surface (maritime), land (ground), or space tracks shall have a capability to perform common tracking

requirements.text: C2 JUs originating real-time Air or Surface tracks shall have automatic correlation capability.
requirements.conditions: If the C2 JU originates real-time air or surface tracks

evidence.quote: All C2 JUs that originate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic correlation capability.

requirements.text: New local Air or Surface tracks shall not be reported until automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on the initial test or next test after tentative correlation.

evidence.quote: New local tracks shall not be reported to the interface until an automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on an initial correlation test or on the next test following an initial tentative correlation

requirements.text: If no tentative correlation is found initially, the C2 JU shall transmit the new track.
requirements.conditions: If no tentative correlation is found on the initial test

evidence.quote: If no tentative correlation is found on the initial test, the new local track shall be transmitted.

requirements.text: If tentative initial correlation is followed by failed next correlation, the C2 JU shall transmit the new track.
requirements.conditions: If the new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test

evidence.quote: If the new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test, the new local track shall be transmitted.

requirements.text: Correlation tests shall include active IUs, remote real-time tracks, and other local tracks.

evidence.quote: Correlation tests shall include active IUs, remote real-time tracks, and other local tracks.

requirements.text: Operator-selective release requires transmission regardless of correlation-test results.
requirements.conditions: If an operator action has been taken which selectively released a new local track for reporting

evidence.quote: it shall be transmitted, regardless of the results of correlation testing.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall perform correlation tests in response to requests under paragraph 4.7.3.2.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs shall perform correlation tests in response to correlation requests from other units in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 4.7.3.2.

requirements.text: The correlation test shall occur no more than 6 seconds after extrapolation time.

evidence.quote: The correlation test shall occur no more than 6 seconds after the extrapolation time.

requirements.text: Simulated and live tracks shall not be tested together.

evidence.quote: Simulated tracks with live tracks, and live tracks with simulated tracks.

requirements.text: Identity-conflicting tracks shall not automatically correlate unless the restriction is inhibited; default restriction applies.
requirements.conditions: Unless inhibited by initialization parameter or operator selection

evidence.quote: The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict

requirements.text: Tracks with different current Mode II codes shall not automatically correlate unless the restriction is inhibited; default restriction applies.
requirements.conditions: Unless inhibited by initialization parameter or operator selection

evidence.quote: The two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current.

requirements.text: Two locally derived real-time tracks shall not automatically correlate.

evidence.quote: Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data.

requirements.text: Strength greater than 1 restricts automatic correlation; No Statement does not inhibit correlation.
requirements.conditions: Systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement

evidence.quote: Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1. Systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement.

requirements.text: A common local track and remote track with the same unit holding R2 shall not automatically correlate.

evidence.quote: One track is a common local track and the other is a remote, and the same unit has R2 for both tracks.

requirements.text: Tracks involved in a dual-designation action concerning another TN shall not automatically correlate.

evidence.quote: Either track is currently the subject of a dual designation resolution action involving another TN.

requirements.text: Operational contingency constraints for engagements, pending command/mission assignment, controlled tracks, and active/inactive IUs shall be applied.

evidence.quote: Each track is subject to one or more (not necessarily the same) of the below operational contingency constraints (OCC).

requirements.text: The specified Unknown/Hostile versus Friend engagement exception may be used, with Unknown/Hostile dropped, but not upon receiving J7.2.
requirements.conditions: Exception to ID conflict and OCC restrictions

evidence.quote: then automatic correlation may be allowed. The Unknown/Hostile track shall be the dropped Track Number (TN-2).
This exception shall not be applied by any JU upon receipt of a J7.2 Correlation message.

requirements.text: Two tracks shall pass correlation tests and restrictions twice before execution.

evidence.quote: Two tracks shall pass the correlation tests and restrictions in paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and 4.4.4.3.1g 2(1-2,1) times before the correlation is executed.

requirements.text: After one successful pass, the pair is tentative and is retested on the next stimulus.

evidence.quote: When two tracks pass the correlation tests and restrictions once, they shall be deemed a tentative correlation.

requirements.text: If conflicting IDs is the only restriction, the C2 JU shall alert the operator to change data, send a difference report, confirm restriction, or coordinate by voice.

evidence.quote: If conflicting IDs is the only correlation restriction, the operator shall be alerted.

requirements.text: A TN with an OCC shall not be automatically selected as dropped.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs shall not automatically select as the TN to be dropped a TN which has any of the OCCs

requirements.text: Without a selection constraint, the higher TN is dropped, using a J7.4 alternate TN above 07777 when present.

evidence.quote: In the absence of such a selection constraint, JUs shall select the higher TN as the TN to be dropped.
For a track that has both a TN greater than 07777 and a TN less than 07777, as reported in a J7.4 message, the track with TN greater than 07777 shall be used in this comparison.

requirements.text: If J7.0 ACT=0 is not received for the dropped TN within 60 seconds, correlation fails and processing is cancelled.

evidence.quote: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds

requirements.text: If the dropped TN is held locally, the retained TN is designated a common local track.

evidence.quote: If own unit holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, the Retained TN shall be designated as a common local track.

requirements.text: If own unit has R2 for the dropped TN, it shall transmit J7.0 ACT=0.

evidence.quote: If own unit has R2 for the Dropped TN, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message shall be transmitted for the Dropped TN.

requirements.text: If another IU reports the dropped TN after J7.0, it is retained remotely and correlation is not reattempted for 60 seconds.

evidence.quote: own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds

requirements.text: When J7.2 is initiated before a Drop Track is received, the dropped TN is retained as remote.

evidence.quote: When a J7.2 message is initiated by own unit and a Drop Track message has not yet been received for the Dropped TN, it shall be retained as a remote track.

requirements.text: On execution, specified kinematic data is transferred from dropped to retained TN and no other dropped-TN data is transferred.

evidence.quote: Data specified below shall be transferred from the Dropped TN to the Retained TN when the correlation is executed. No other Dropped TN data shall be transferred to the Retained TN.
If the Dropped TN is a local or common local track, the Dropped TN Latitude, Longitude, Course, Speed, Altitude, Altitude Source, TQ, and Strength shall be transferred to the Retained TN.

requirements.text: When ID restriction is not inhibited and dropped ID is automatically accepted, dropped ID/IAD and specified identification data transfer.
requirements.conditions: Restriction Not Inhibited

evidence.quote: the Dropped TN ID/IAD and Special Interest Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type shall be transferred to Retained TN.

requirements.text: When ID restriction is inhibited and identities differ, the last dropped identity is treated as an identity difference report immediately after correlation.
requirements.conditions: Restriction Inhibited

evidence.quote: the last Identity reported for Dropped TN shall be considered equivalent to a J7.0 (ACT = 1) Identity Difference Report

requirements.text: Nonzero dropped Mode I/II/III data transfers only when retained mode data is zero, and higher Mode IV data transfers.

evidence.quote: Any Dropped TN nonzero Mode I, II, or III IFF/SIF data for a mode for which the Retained TN data is zero shall be transferred
If the Dropped TN Mode IV data is a higher value than the Retained TN Mode IV data, it shall be transferred to the Retained TN.

requirements.text: Force Tell or Emergency Indicator 1 on the dropped TN is carried to the retained TN.

evidence.quote: If the Dropped TN had the Force Tell Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the Force Tell Indicator set to value 1.
If the Dropped TN had the Emergency Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the Emergency Indicator set to value 1.

requirements.text: C2 JUs initiating real-time Air or Surface tracks shall have automatic decorrelation capability.
requirements.conditions: If the C2 JU initiates real-time air or surface tracks

evidence.quote: All C2 JUs that initiate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic decorrelation capability.

requirements.text: Automatic decorrelation tests are performed for common local tracks upon each J2/J3 message received on the track.

evidence.quote: Automatic decorrelation tests shall be performed for each common local track upon receipt of each J2 or J3 message on the track.

requirements.text: After decorrelation, the local track is tested once against non-common remote tracks; if it fails, it is assigned a new TN and reported in J3.2/J3.3 with Pending ID.

evidence.quote: If the automatic correlation test fails, assign a new TN (TN B) to the local track and report TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message, with an initial ID of Pending.

requirements.text: For manual decorrelation, the Pending ID may be overridden.

evidence.quote: For manual decorrelation the Pending ID may be overridden by operator action.

requirements.text: A locally held track controlled by the C2 JU shall not be automatically decorrelated.

evidence.quote: TN A is controlled by own unit; i.e., is the subject of own unit reported J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message. Do not automatically decorrelate.

requirements.text: Decorrelation is delayed while a handover is in progress until completion or termination.

evidence.quote: The decorrelation shall be delayed until the handover process is completed or terminated

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report geodetic latitude and longitude for Air and Surface tracks.

evidence.quote: The geodetic latitude and longitude for each Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) track shall be reported

requirements.text: Speed is reported in data miles per hour of ground speed and course in degrees relative to true north.

evidence.quote: The speed shall be reported in data miles per hour of ground speed. The course shall be reported in degrees with respect to true north.

requirements.text: For implemented Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest fields, all defined values shall be accepted for retransmission and operator appreciation after R2 assumption.

evidence.quote: the JU shall accept all defined field values for retransmission and operator appreciation, in the event of assuming R2 for a previously-reported track.

requirements.text: After assuming R2, accepted values are retransmitted unless differing local non-No Statement data exists, in which case local data is reported.

evidence.quote: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R2, unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement
In the latter case, the JU shall report the locally derived data.

requirements.text: Non-No Statement Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type data from the controlling unit is retransmitted regardless of local data.

evidence.quote: non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.

requirements.text: Special Interest Indicator 1 shall be retransmitted as 1 by any C2 JU assuming R2.

evidence.quote: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R2.

requirements.text: Strength shall be exchanged for Air and Surface tracks to indicate the number of aircraft or ships comprising the track.

evidence.quote: The strength of the reported Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) track shall be exchanged

requirements.text: For nonreal-time reports, the valid position time is reported in hour and minute fields of the J3 Amplification word.

evidence.quote: This time shall be reported in the hour and minute fields of the J3 Amplification continuation word.

requirements.text: The first C2 JU to report an Air or Surface track has R2.

evidence.quote: The first JU to report the track has R2 on that track.

requirements.text: Air or Surface reports are transmitted only by the C2 JU with R2.

evidence.quote: A JU transmits a track report for an Air, Surface (Maritime) or Land (Ground) track only when it has R2 for that track.

requirements.text: R2 is assumed when local real-time data is held after nonreal-time data was received.

evidence.quote: A JU assumes R2 if it has local real-time data and nonreal-time data were received.

requirements.text: R2 is assumed after approximately 40 seconds without a remote Air or Surface report.

evidence.quote: A JU assumes R2 if it has not received a remote report on a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track for approximately 40 seconds

requirements.text: After J7.0 ACT=0 on a local track, R2 is assumed at the next opportunity if eligibility remains and no remote report was received.

evidence.quote: A JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track shall assume R2 at the next opportunity

requirements.text: Immediately before assuming R2 after a Drop Track message, correlation is tested once.

evidence.quote: Immediately prior to assuming R2 for an air or surface track after receipt of a Drop Track message, a JU shall test the track for correlation in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g, except the test shall be conducted only once.

requirements.text: R2 may be assumed after a J2 PPLI NPS state of Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure if eligibility remains and no remote report is received.

evidence.quote: may assume R2 at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.

requirements.text: R2 is retained until relinquished under the rules or the track is dropped.

evidence.quote: A JU with R2 on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.

requirements.text: J7.0 ACT=0 is transmitted when the C2 JU ceases reporting an R2 track, except when R2 has been relinquished to another JU.
requirements.conditions: Except when a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU, or when that track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN

evidence.quote: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R2

requirements.text: J7.0 ACT=0 is not transmitted when the track becomes an Active IU with the same TN.

evidence.quote: When that track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.

requirements.text: When a remote track is automatically purged after a system-selected interval without updates, J7.0 ACT=0 is not transmitted.

evidence.quote:
Each system should 
have the capability to automatically purge those tracks after a specific time 
interval.
Under this condition, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.

requirements.text: After Active startup or return from Inactive/TDS Failure, tracks are not transmitted until sufficient R2 checks, correlation, and data registration occur; this applies to receive-filter deactivation.

evidence.quote: shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed

requirements.text: The C2 JU observes a 12-second minimum wait before reporting Air and Surface tracks.

evidence.quote: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds

requirements.text: When two Air or Surface tracks are recognized as eligible for correlation, J7.2 is initiated and retained and dropped TNs are identified.

evidence.quote: The recognizing JU shall transmit the J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C2 IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks. The message identifies the TN to be retained and the TN to be dropped.

requirements.text: C2 JUs capable of Air or Surface reporting shall transmit and receive all J7.2 response values for locally held real-time tracks.

evidence.quote: All C2 JUs capable of reporting air or surface tracks shall have the capability to transmit and receive all the response values of the J7.2 message

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall use PPLI data available from J2 messages to reduce the redundancy of surveillance track reporting.

evidence.quote: PPLI data available from J2 messages shall be used by C2 JUs to reduce the redundancy of surveillance track reporting.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and perform the applicable correlation and conflict processing necessary to ensure that duplicative information is not being transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence.quote: A surveillance JU will accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and perform the applicable correlation and conflict processing necessary to ensure that duplicative information is not being transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall attempt to correlate received PPLI reports with data being received from local sensors.
requirements.conditions: If participating on the Surveillance Network PG

evidence.quote: A C2 JU participating on the Surveillance Network PG shall attempt to correlate received PPLI reports with data being received from local sensors.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall transmit the J7.2 Correlation message with the Response Value (RV) field set to value 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), and with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN, if a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2.

evidence.quote: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2 the J7.2 Correlation message shall be transmitted with the Response Value (RV) field set to value 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), and with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN if a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2.

evidence.quote: The C2 JU shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall transmit the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN, if a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different.

evidence.quote: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track if a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same.
requirements.conditions: Except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0

evidence.quote: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall accept the surveillance track and discard the PPLI message if Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0.
requirements.conditions: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same

evidence.quote: in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture if a correlation is not found.

evidence.quote: If a correlation is not found, the C2 JU shall integrate the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall assume no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG if J2 messages are not received subsequent to integrating the PPLI report and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data.

evidence.quote: If J2 messages are not received subsequent to this action and the receiving C2 JU still has no local data, the C2 JU assumes no responsibility for reporting the subject JU on the Surveillance Network PG.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall decorrelate the PPLI and local track data if the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria.

evidence.quote: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data shall be decorrelated.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number after decorrelation.

evidence.quote: After decorrelation, the C2 JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field as No Statement after decorrelation.

evidence.quote: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall both be reported as No Statement.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall assume R2 of an IU in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data and a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds.

evidence.quote: A C2 JU shall assume R2 of an IU (including C2 and nonC2 JUs and forwarded PUs and RUs) in accordance with the reporting rules for a real-time track if the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data, when: a. A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall assume R2 of an IU if a J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence.
requirements.conditions: If the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data

evidence.quote: b. A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall assume R2 of an IU if a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU.
requirements.conditions: If the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data

evidence.quote: c. A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall assume R2 of an IU if the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
requirements.conditions: If the C2 JU has correlated local sensor data

evidence.quote: d. The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report an IU for which it assumes R2 as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence.quote: A C2 JU assuming R2 of an IU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the Identity as Friend for an IU for which it assumes R2.

evidence.quote: The Identity shall be reported as Friend.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the Track Number, Platform and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages for an IU for which it assumes R2.

evidence.quote: The Track Number, Platform and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages shall be reported.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator as value 1 for an IU for which it assumes R2.

evidence.quote: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall maintain the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator as value 1 if another C2 JU assumes R2 of the IU.

evidence.quote: and shall be maintained if another C2 JU assumes R2 of the IU.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the most current IFF/SIF data for an IU for which it assumes R2.

evidence.quote: The most current IFF/SIF data shall be reported.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message as value 2 if all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from or are the same as the codes received in the J2 message for the subject TN.

evidence.quote: If all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from or are the same as the codes received in the J2 message for the subject TN, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message shall be reported as value 2.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator as value 1 if the Mode II code was obtained from or is the same as the Mode II code received in the J2 message.
requirements.conditions: Otherwise (if not all codes match)

evidence.quote: Otherwise, if the Mode II code was obtained from or is the same as the Mode II code received in the J2 message, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator shall be reported as value 1.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator as value 0 otherwise.

evidence.quote: Otherwise, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator shall be reported as value 0.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall base the Mode IV Indicator value reported on actual responses received and shall not base it on the fact that the TN was previously received in a PPLI message.

evidence.quote: The Mode IV Indicator value reported shall be based on actual responses received and shall not be based on the fact that the TN was previously received in a PPLI message.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report locally derived IFF/SIF data if it differs from IFF/SIF data that was being reported in the PPLI message.

evidence.quote: If locally derived IFF/SIF data differs from IFF/SIF data that was being reported in the PPLI message, the locally derived data shall be reported.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall set the Simulation Indicator in the appropriate J3 message as well as in the J2 message when applicable to indicate that a surveillance track is a simulated track.

evidence.quote: This is accomplished by setting the Simulation Indicator in the appropriate J3 message as well as in the J2 message when applicable.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall set the Simulation Indicator in the J2 and J3 messages on all simulated tracks when both live and simulated tracks are simultaneously being exchanged on the interface.

evidence.quote: The Simulation Indicator in the J2 and J3 messages shall be set on all simulated tracks when both live and simulated tracks are simultaneously being exchanged on the interface.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not associate simulated tracks with a live track.
requirements.conditions: When the Simulation Indicator is set in a J2 or J3 message

evidence.quote: When the Simulation Indicator is set in a J2 or J3 message, all data associated with that track are simulated and should not be associated with a live track.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not correlate simulated tracks with live tracks.

evidence.quote: Simulated tracks will not be correlated with live tracks.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not change the Simulation Indicator.

evidence.quote: The Simulation Indicator shall not change.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall drop the track using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and report a new track if it is desired to change the simulation status of a track.
requirements.conditions: Except that a change from live to simulated shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU

evidence.quote: If for any reason, such as operator error, it is desired to change the simulation status of a track, the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, and a new track shall be reported. The one exception to this rule is that a change from live to simulated shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall manage its database to insure that it shall not be saturated by force tell and emergency alerts if it has a limited track capacity.

evidence.quote: A system with a limited track capacity (e.g., F-15) should manage its database to insure that it shall not be saturated by force tell and emergency alerts.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a purged remote track/point.

evidence.quote: The JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a purged remote track/point.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall implement the Reset to No Statement value if it implements the No Statement value and at least one other defined value for a field that has a Reset to No Statement value.

evidence.quote: When a JU implements the No Statement value and at least one other defined value for a field that has a Reset to No Statement value, the Reset to No Statement value must also be implemented.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall transmit a message reporting the Reset to No Statement value one time.

evidence.quote: A message reporting the Reset to No Statement value shall be transmitted one time.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall retain the locally held value regardless of whether it was locally or remotely derived when it receives a No Statement value for a field which has a Reset to No Statement value and for which a value other than No Statement is locally held.

evidence.quote: When a system receives a No Statement value for a field which has a Reset to No Statement value and for which a value other than No Statement is locally held, the locally held value shall be retained regardless of whether it was locally or remotely derived.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall automatically revert the locally held value of that field to No Statement when it receives a Reset to No Statement value.

evidence.quote: When a system receives a Reset to No Statement value, it shall automatically revert the locally held value of that field to No Statement.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall transmit a Drop Track Report on the old TN in cases when a new TN is required for a surveillance entity retaining its original Track Number on change of report type.

evidence.quote: In cases when a new TN is required, the JU with R2 shall transmit a Drop Track Report on the old TN.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall decorrelate and alert an operator as a cue to transmit the J10.2 message with the Weapon Engagement Status field set to value 8 (Engagement Broken) if appropriate, if TN A is the Target TN of a J10.2 Engagement Status message for a current engagement.

evidence.quote: Decorrelate and alert an operator as a cue to transmit the J10.2 message with the Weapon Engagement Status field set to value 8 (Engagement Broken) if appropriate.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall transmit another J10.2 message with the new TN only if initiated by operator action, by a WILCO response to a J12.0 Mission Assignment against TN B, or by receipt of a J12.6 Target Sorting message reporting an engagement against TN B.

evidence.quote: Another J10.2 message with the new TN shall be transmitted only if initiated by operator action, by a WILCO response to a J12.0 Mission Assignment against TN B, or by receipt of a J12.6 Target Sorting message reporting an engagement against TN B.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall execute the decorrelation and provide operator display of new track status on TNs A and B before release of the J9.0 reply if TN A is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message.

evidence.quote: Execute the decorrelation and provide operator display of new track status on TNs A and B before release of the J9.0 reply.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall make the J9.0 reply relative to TN A only.

evidence.quote: The reply shall be relative to TN A only.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall alert the operator as a cue to report termination of control TN A if appropriate if TN A is manually decorrelated.

evidence.quote: If manually decorrelated, alert the operator as a cue to report termination of control TN A if appropriate.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report commencement of control of TN B using the J10.5 message only if initiated by operator action.

evidence.quote: Report commencement of control of TN B using the J10.5 message only if initiated by operator action.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall decorrelate and continue reporting control of TN A if the controlled track is a nonC2 JU.

evidence.quote: If the controlled track is a nonC2 JU, then decorrelate and continue reporting control of TN A.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall decorrelate and alert an operator as a cue to terminate the pairing on TN A and initiate the pairing on TN B if appropriate if TN A has been paired by own unit.

evidence.quote: Decorrelate and alert an operator as a cue to terminate the pairing on TN A and initiate the pairing on TN B if appropriate.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall assess whether the Index Number should remain with TN A or B, and transmit J12.5 messages as appropriate if TN A has been correlated with an Index Number by own unit.

evidence.quote: Assess whether the Index Number should remain with TN A or B, and transmit J12.5 messages as appropriate.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall execute the decorrelation and alert an operator as a cue to report control in the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message as appropriate after the handover process is completed or terminated.

evidence.quote: then the decorrelation shall be executed and an operator alerted as a cue to report control in the J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message as appropriate.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall provide operator display of the pending decorrelation.

evidence.quote: Operator display of the pending decorrelation shall be provided.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not cause the transmission of a change report for changes from a Valid Data value to a No Data status as a result of the clearing function (J7.5 (ACT = 0)).

evidence.quote: Changes from a Valid Data value to a No Data status as a result of the clearing function (J7.5 (ACT = 0)) will not cause the transmission of a change report.

target.name: Resolve Dual Designations via Track Correlation

scope.goal: Define requirements for a C2 JU to resolve real-time air and surface track dual designations through automatic and manual track correlation, J7.2 Correlation messages, reverse correlations/rejections, related J7.0 drop action, and associated correlation/decorrelation processing.
scope.start_boundary: When a C2 JU recognizes, tests, or is requested to correlate locally/remotely reported real-time air or surface tracks that may represent the same object or dual designation.
scope.success_boundary: The C2 JU originates, receives, accepts, rejects, reverses, executes, abandons, or fails the correlation according to the specified tests, restrictions, timers, and Track Number/R2 actions; decorrelation processing is included where the source makes it part of common tracking and dual-designation handling.
in_scope: Common tracking and correlation/decorrelation of local track data with received remote data
Automatic and manual air/surface track correlation
Periodic, receive-triggered, and pre-transmission correlation checks
J7.2 Correlation message origination and reception
Retained and Dropped Track Number selection
Response Values 0, 1, 2, and 3
Reverse correlation and correlation rejection
J7.0 Drop Track Report when the C2 JU has R2 for the dropped track
Correlation timing and position/course/speed/altitude tests
Correlation prohibitions, restrictions, parameter defaults, and two-test confirmation
Data retention or transfer upon execution of correlation
Automatic and manual decorrelation procedures supporting common tracking
Minimum waiting and filter constraints directly affecting correlation and resumption of track reporting
out_of_scope: NonC2 JU transmission behavior on the Surveillance NPG
Point-to-point or point-to-track correlation using J7.2
Subsurface track correlation procedures
Ballistic missile track correlation, covariance encoding, and J7.1 ACT=2 update procedures
Land and space dual designation resolution, which is TBD in the supplied text
Electronic warfare LOB/fix correlation; only EW AOP rules explicitly involving J7.2 are outside this air/surface track target

evidence.quote: 4.7.3 RESOLUTION OF AIR AND SURFACE TRACK DUAL DESIGNATIONS

When a C2 JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation, that JU shall initiate action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation. The recognizing JU shall transmit the J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C2 IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks.

all C2 JUs shall perform correlation and decorrelation of their local track data with respect to the remote data which they are receiving. Failure to properly correlate can result in a dual designation.
All C2 JUs that originate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic correlation capability.
All C2 JUs that initiate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic decorrelation capability.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall perform correlation and decorrelation of its local track data with respect to the remote data it receives; a C2 JU capable of originating and reporting real-time air, surface, land, or space tracks shall have a common-tracking capability, with air and surface procedures governing this target.

evidence.quote: all C2 JUs shall perform correlation and decorrelation of their local track data with respect to the remote data which they are receiving.
Each C2 JU which has a capability to originate and report real-time air, surface (maritime), land (ground), or space tracks shall have a capability to perform common tracking

requirements.text: A C2 JU that originates real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic correlation capability.

evidence.quote: All C2 JUs that originate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic correlation capability.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall periodically compare remote tracks to local tracks, and optionally common local tracks, using the frequency, same-object criteria, and correlation rules in section 4.4.4.3.1 to determine whether an air or surface dual designation occurred; land and space dual-designation rules are TBD.

evidence.quote: The recognition and resolution of dual designations require all IUs to periodically compare remote tracks to local tracks (and, optionally, to common local tracks) to determine if a dual designation has occurred. The frequency of such comparisons the criteria for determining that two tracks represent the same object, and the correlation rules shall be in accordance with section 4.4.4.3.1
The rules for land (ground) and space track dual designation resolution are TBD.

requirements.text: When a C2 JU recognizes two tracks reported to the interface as eligible for correlation, it shall initiate automatic or manual action to resolve the dual designation and shall transmit a J7.2 Correlation message identifying the TN to be retained and the TN to be dropped.

evidence.quote: When a C² JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation, that JU shall initiate action, either automatically or manually, to resolve the dual designation. The recognizing JU shall transmit the J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C² IUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks. The message identifies the TN to be retained and the TN to be dropped.

requirements.text: A C2 JU capable of reporting air or surface tracks shall be capable of transmitting and receiving all J7.2 response values for real-time air and/or surface tracks held locally by its system.

evidence.quote: All C² JUs capable of reporting air or surface tracks shall have the capability to transmit and receive all the response values of the J7.2 message for real-time air and/or surface tracks, which are held locally by their system.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not report a new local track to the interface until automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on the initial test, or on the next test after an initial tentative correlation; if no tentative correlation is found initially, the track shall be transmitted, and if tentative correlation is followed by failure, it shall be transmitted.

evidence.quote: New local tracks shall not be reported to the interface until an automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on an initial correlation test or on the next test following an initial tentative correlation (see paragraph 4.4.4.3.1h). If no tentative correlation is found on the initial test, the new local track shall be transmitted. If the new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test, the new local track shall be transmitted.

requirements.text: A new local track that correlates with another track on each of the first two correlation tests shall be correlated and held as a common local track, after which decorrelation rules apply.

evidence.quote: A new local track that correlates with another track on each of the first two correlation tests shall be correlated and held as a common local track. Thereafter, the decorrelation rules (see paragraph 4.4.4.3.2) apply to the track.

requirements.text: Correlation tests performed by a C2 JU shall include active IUs, remote real-time tracks, and other local tracks.

evidence.quote: Correlation tests shall include active IUs, remote real-time tracks, and other local tracks.

requirements.text: If operator action selectively releases a new local track for reporting, the C2 JU shall transmit it regardless of correlation-test results.
requirements.conditions: {"operator_action":"selective release of a new local track for reporting"}

evidence.quote: If an operator action has been taken which selectively released a new local track for reporting, it shall be transmitted, regardless of the results of correlation testing.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall perform correlation tests in response to correlation requests from other units in accordance with paragraph 4.7.3.2.
requirements.conditions: {"trigger":"Receives a correlation request from another unit"}

evidence.quote: C2 JUs shall perform correlation tests in response to correlation requests from other units in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 4.7.3.2.

requirements.text: When both tracks have speed at least 10 dmh, a C2 JU shall apply the course differential test MIN(|CR-CL|, 360-|CR-CL|) ≤ f; otherwise course shall not be used.
requirements.conditions: {"speed_condition":"both tracks have speed ≥ 10 dmh"}

evidence.quote: If both tracks have speed ≥ 10 dmh:
MIN(|CR-CL|, 360-|CR-CL|) ≤ f
Otherwise course is not used in the correlation test.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall apply the speed differential test |1-SS/SF| X 100% ≤ MAX(g,[g(k/SF)]), using k=200 dmh for air tracks and k=20 dmh for surface tracks.

evidence.quote: Speed Test |1-SS/SF| X 100% ≤ MAX(g,[g(k/SF)])
= 200 dmh for air tracks; = 20 dmh for surface tracks.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not automatically correlate two locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data.
requirements.conditions: {"restriction":"both tracks locally derived real-time tracks"}

evidence.quote: Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not automatically correlate tracks when either track has Strength greater than 1; if either Strength is No Statement, the C2 JU shall not inhibit correlation for this restriction.
requirements.conditions: {"restriction":"either track Strength > 1"}

evidence.quote: Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1. Systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not automatically correlate a common local track with a remote track when the same unit has R2 for both tracks.
requirements.conditions: {"restriction":"same unit has R2 for common local and remote tracks"}

evidence.quote: One track is a common local track and the other is a remote, and the same unit has R² for both tracks.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not automatically correlate tracks when each is subject to one or more operational contingency constraints, including current engagement status, pending command or mission assignment requiring reply, control by a J10.5 report, or active/inactive IU status.
requirements.conditions: {"restriction":"each track is subject to one or more OCCs"}

evidence.quote: Each track is subject to one or more (not necessarily the same) of the below operational contingency constraints (OCC).
The TN is the subject of a current engagement status message
The TN is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message
The TN is currently a controlled track
The TN is an active or inactive IU.

requirements.text: A C2 JU may apply one exception to the identity-conflict and current-engagement restrictions if the unit attempting correlation originated a J10.2 where its target has Unknown or Hostile ID and the other track has Friend ID; the Unknown/Hostile track shall be the dropped TN, and this exception shall not be applied upon receipt of a J7.2 Correlation message.
requirements.conditions: {"exception":"unit attempting correlation originated J10.2 and target is Unknown/Hostile while other is Friend"}

evidence.quote: If either subject track is the Target TN in a J10.2 Engagement Status message originated by the unit attempting correlation, and that track has an ID of Unknown or Hostile, and the other subject track has an ID of Friend, then automatic correlation may be allowed. The Unknown/Hostile track shall be the dropped Track Number (TN-2).
This exception shall not be applied by any JU upon receipt of a J7.2 Correlation message.

requirements.text: A C2 JU receiving a J7.2 while holding OCCs on both tracks or conflicting IDs with the ID-conflict restriction enabled shall reject the correlation under paragraph 4.7.3.2a(1).
requirements.conditions: {"trigger":"Receipt of J7.2 with both-track OCCs or enabled ID conflict"}

evidence.quote: Thus, any JU receiving a J7.2 Correlation message and also holding OCCs on both tracks or conflicting IDs on the two tracks (if the ID conflict correlation restriction is enabled (see paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g(1)) shall reject the correlation in accordance with paragraph 4.7.3.2a(1).

requirements.text: If conflicting IDs is the only correlation restriction, the C2 JU shall alert the operator to change local ID or Exercise Indicator and ID, transmit an ID Difference Report, confirm the restriction, or conduct voice coordination.
requirements.conditions: {"only_restriction":"conflicting IDs"}

evidence.quote: If conflicting IDs is the only correlation restriction, the operator shall be alerted. The purpose of this alert is to cue the operator to take one of the following actions: (a) Change the local ID or the Exercise Indicator and ID, thereby allowing automatic correlation, or (b) Transmit an ID Difference Report, thereby allowing automatic correlation if the remote ID or Exercise Indicator and ID is changed, or (c) Confirm the restriction, thereby inhibiting the correlation, or (d) Conduct voice coordination to resolve the situation.

requirements.text: If actions resolve an ID conflict, the C2 JU shall test the TN to be retained for decorrelation once before executing the correlation.
requirements.conditions: {"prerequisite":"ID conflict resolved"}

evidence.quote: If the above actions result in resolution of the ID conflict, the TN to be retained shall be tested for decorrelation in accordance with paragraph 4.4.4.3.2a before executing the correlation, except the test shall be conducted only once.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not automatically select a TN with any listed OCC as the dropped TN; absent such a constraint, it shall select the higher TN as dropped, using the TN greater than 07777 for comparison when a track has both representations in a J7.4 message.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs shall not automatically select as the TN to be dropped a TN which has any of the OCCs listed in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g(6 7). In the absence of such a selection constraint, JUs shall select the higher TN as the TN to be dropped. For a track that has both a TN greater than 07777 and a TN less than 07777, as reported in a J7.4 message, the track with TN greater than 07777 shall be used in this comparison.

requirements.text: If no J7.0 ACT=0 is received for the dropped TN within 60 seconds after transmission of the correlation request, the C2 JU shall deem the correlation failed and cancel all associated correlation processing.
requirements.conditions: {"timeout":"60 seconds without J7.0 ACT=0 for dropped TN"}

evidence.quote: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.

requirements.text: If own unit holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, the C2 JU shall designate the Retained TN as a common local track.

evidence.quote: If own unit holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, the Retained TN shall be designated as a common local track.

requirements.text: If the C2 JU has R2 for the Dropped TN, it shall transmit a J7.0 ACT=0 Drop Track message for that TN; if another IU reports the Dropped TN afterward, the C2 JU shall retain it as remote and shall not reattempt correlation between Retained and Dropped TNs for 60 seconds after the J7.0 transmission.
requirements.conditions: {"r2_for_dropped":true}

evidence.quote: If own unit has R² for the Dropped TN, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message shall be transmitted for the Dropped TN. If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0, own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.

requirements.text: When own unit initiates a J7.2 and no Drop Track message has yet been received for the Dropped TN, the C2 JU shall retain it as a remote track.

evidence.quote: When a J7.2 message is initiated by own unit and a Drop Track message has not yet been received for the Dropped TN, it shall be retained as a remote track.

requirements.text: When the identity-conflict restriction is inhibited, the C2 JU shall retain reported identification data when identities are the same; when identities differ, it shall treat the last Dropped TN Identity as equivalent to a J7.0 ACT=1 Identity Difference Report and process it under paragraph 4.7.1.2.2 immediately after correlation.
requirements.conditions: {"id_restriction_state":"inhibited"}

evidence.quote: Restriction Inhibited: When the Identity of Retained TN and Dropped TN are the same, associated identification data (Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, Exercise Indicator, and Special Interest Indicator) reported for the Retained TN shall be retained. When the Identity of Retained TN and Dropped TN are different, the last Identity reported for Dropped TN shall be considered equivalent to a J7.0 (ACT = 1) Identity Difference Report for the Retained TN. It shall be processed in accordance with paragraph 4.7.1.2.2 immediately after the correlation is executed.

requirements.text: If the Dropped TN had Force Tell Indicator 1 or Emergency Indicator 1, the C2 JU shall set the corresponding indicator on the Retained TN.

evidence.quote: If the Dropped TN had the Force Tell Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the Force Tell Indicator set to value 1. If the Dropped TN had the Emergency Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the Emergency Indicator set to value 1.

requirements.text: A C2 JU that initiates real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic decorrelation capability and may perform manual decorrelation or require manual confirmation of automatic decorrelations.

evidence.quote: All C2 JUs that initiate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic decorrelation capability. C2 JUs may also perform manual decorrelation, and may have a capability to require manual confirmation of automatic decorrelations.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall perform automatic decorrelation tests for each common local track upon receipt of each J2 or J3 message on that track.
requirements.conditions: {"trigger":"Receives each J2 or J3 message on a common local track"}

evidence.quote: Automatic decorrelation tests shall be performed for each common local track upon receipt of each J2 or J3 message on the track.

requirements.text: After decorrelation criteria are met, the C2 JU shall automatically test the local track once for correlation against remote tracks that are not common local tracks; if the test fails, it shall assign a new TN and report it in J3.2/J3.3 with initial ID Pending, except manual decorrelation may allow operator override of Pending.

evidence.quote: The local track shall be automatically tested once for correlation against remote tracks (not common local tracks) in accordance with paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and g. a selection conflict occurs due to OCCs on both the Retained TN and the 
Dropped TN the correlation shall be abandoned until the next correlation 
check.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only RV-setting requirement duplicates A:D002/B:D054 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: The RV field shall be set to: value 0 if there is no OCC on the Retained TN. 1 if the Retained TN has an OCC. 3 if the correlation was manually initiated.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only J7.2 discontinuation requirement duplicates B:D056 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
Transmission of a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 0 or 
1 shall be discontinued upon receipt of a J7.2 message containing one or both 
of the same TNs.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only originating-JU drop/J7.0 requirement duplicates B:D057 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
If the originating C2 JU holds R2 for the Dropped TN, it shall drop 
the Dropped TN and transmit the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.  The J7.0 (ACT = 0) 
message shall be transmitted after the J7.2 message.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only operator-selectable J7.2 deactivation requirement duplicates B:D058 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs capable of transmitting the J7.2 message shall have an 
operator selectable capability to deactivate automatic transmission of the 
message.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only J7.2 response-value capability requirement duplicates A:D005/B:D005 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: All C2 JUs capable of reporting air or surface tracks shall have the capability to transmit and receive all the response values of the J7.2 message for real-time air and/or surface tracks, which are held locally by their system.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only RV 0/1 restriction rejection requirement duplicates A:D003/B:D059 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 0 or 
1 shall not accept the requested correlation when local or remote data held 
indicates one or more of the following conditions exist: 
 
 
 
(1)  There is a correlation restriction as listed in paragraph 
4.4.4.3.1g.  In this case the correlation shall be rejected.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only decorrelation-based rejection requirement duplicates B:D060 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(2)  The Retained TN and the Dropped TN will decorrelate, i.e., 
when subjected to the decorrelation criteria once, the tracks would 
decorrelate.  In this case the correlation shall be rejected.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only RV=0 dropped-TN OCC reverse-correlation requirement duplicates B:D061 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(3)  There is an OCC on the Dropped TN as listed in paragraph 
4.4.4.3.1g(7) and the received RV field is set to value 0. The reverse 
correlation shall be transmitted if the new Dropped TN has no correlation 
constraint.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only combined dropped-TN OCC rejection/reverse requirement overlaps B:D061 and B:D062; split into the same confirmed rows.

evidence.quote: If both the Retained TN and Dropped TN have an OCC, the correlation shall be rejected. ... (4) There is an OCC on the Dropped TN as listed in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g(7) and the received RV field is set to value 1. In this case, the correlation shall be rejected.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only RV=2 lockout requirement duplicates A:D004/B:D063 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs receiving or generating a J7.2 message with the RV field set 
to value 2, Correlation Rejection, shall not automatically originate a 
request with the same Retained TN and Dropped TN for a period of 2(1-10,1) 
minutes.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only RV=3 acceptance/rejection requirement duplicates B:D064 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 3 shall automatically accept the requested correlation unless one of the following restrictions applies, in which case the correlation shall be rejected: (1) The two tracks are of a different E/C... (2) One track is simulated and the other is live. (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only manual-correlation decorrelation suppression duplicates B:D065 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
Note:  After acceptance of a manual correlation the resulting track shall not 
be the subject of automatic decorrelation processing for a period of 5 
minutes.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only rejection J7.2 transmission duplicates A:D004/B:D066 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs rejecting the requested correlation shall initiate 
transmission of a J7.2 message with the Retained TN/Dropped TN set as 
received and RV field set to value 2.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only reverse-correlation J7.2 transmission duplicates B:D067 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs responding with a reverse correlation shall transmit the J7.2 
message with the originally received Retained TN and Dropped TN reversed and 
the RV field set to value 1.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only no-action-when-not-holding-dropped-TN requirement duplicates B:D068 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs not holding the Dropped TN shall not take any further action.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only retained-not-held/dropped-held processing duplicates B:D069 and B:D070 and is source-supported; split into the same confirmed rows.

evidence.quote: If the Retained TN is not held but the Dropped TN is held, the correlation request shall be processed as follows: (1) If the Dropped TN has an OCC... (a) If RV is set to 0, transmit a reverse correlation with RV set to 1. (b) If RV is set to 1, transmit a correlation rejection with RV set to 2. (c) If RV is set to 3, execute the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number. (2) If the Dropped TN does not have an OCC, execute the correlation using Dropped TN data and Retained TN track number.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only rejected-J7.2 R2 interpretation rule duplicates B:D071 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs rejecting a J7.2 message and holding the Dropped TN as a 
local or common local track shall not interpret the J7.2 message as a Drop 
Track message for the purpose of determining R2.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only overlapping-TN J7.2 collision rule duplicates B:D072 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: If the received J7.2 message contains one or both of the same TNs, as contained in the transmission of the own unit J7.2 message sequence in progress, the following actions shall be taken: (1) If the own unit RV field is set to value 0, 1, or 3, discontinue transmission of the own unit J7.2 message and process the received message... (2) If the own unit RV field is set to value 2, complete the transmission of the message sequence in progress.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only two-test correlation execution requirement duplicates B:D034 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
Two tracks shall pass the correlation 
tests and restrictions in paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and 4.4.4.3.1g 2(1-2,1) times 
before the correlation is executed.  When two tracks pass the correlation 
tests and restrictions once, they shall be deemed a tentative correlation.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only 60-second correlation failure timeout duplicates B:D039 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is 
received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the 
transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the 
correlation shall be cancelled.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only retained-TN common-local designation duplicates B:D040 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(a)  If own unit holds the Dropped TN as a local or common 
local track, the Retained TN shall be designated as a common local track.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only R2 dropped-TN J7.0 transmission duplicates B:D041 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(b)  If own unit has R2 for the Dropped TN, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) 
Drop Track message shall be transmitted for the Dropped TN.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only post-J7.0 dropped-TN retention/no-recorrelation duplicates B:D041 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
If the Dropped 
TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0, own unit shall 
retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate 
the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after 
transmission of the J7.0.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only J7.2-initiated dropped-TN remote retention duplicates B:D042 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(c)  When a J7.2 message is initiated by own unit and a 
Drop Track message has not yet been received for the Dropped TN, it shall be 
retained as a remote track.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only kinematic data transfer duplicates B:D043 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(a)  Kinematic Data.  If the Dropped TN is a local or 
common local track, the Dropped TN Latitude, Longitude, Course, Speed, 
Altitude, Altitude Source, TQ, and Strength shall be transferred to the 
Retained TN.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only IFF/SIF transfer duplicates B:D046 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: (c) IFF/SIF Data. Any Dropped TN nonzero Mode I, II, or III IFF/SIF data for a mode for which the Retained TN data is zero shall be transferred to the Retained TN. If the Dropped TN Mode IV data is a higher value than the Retained TN Mode IV data, it shall be transferred to the Retained TN.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only Force Tell/Emergency indicator transfer duplicates B:D047 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(d)  Force Tell and Emergency Indicators. If the Dropped TN 
had the Force Tell Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the 
Force Tell Indicator set to value 1.  If the Dropped TN had the Emergency 
Indicator set to value 1, the Retained TN shall have the Emergency Indicator 
set to value 1.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only identity-conflict automatic restriction duplicates B:D025 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict... Systems shall have an initialization parameter and an operator selectable capability to inhibit this automatic restriction.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only Mode II conflict restriction duplicates B:D026 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(2)  The two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local 
Mode II code is current.  Systems shall have an initialization parameter and 
an operator selectable capability to inhibit this automatic restriction.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only local-real-time correlation restriction duplicates B:D027 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(3)  Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., 
being updated with local positional data.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only Strength restriction duplicates B:D028 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(4)  Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater 
than 1.  Systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength 
set to No Statement.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only same-unit R2 restriction duplicates B:D029 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(5)  One track is a common local track and the other is a remote, 
and the same unit has R2 for both tracks.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only existing-resolution-action restriction duplicates B:D030 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(6)  Either track is currently the subject of a dual designation 
resolution action involving another TN.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only OCC restriction duplicates B:D031 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: (7) Each track is subject to one or more (not necessarily the same) of the below operational contingency constraints (OCC). (a) The TN is the subject of a current engagement status message... (b) The TN is the subject of a pending J9.0 Command message... (c) The TN is currently a controlled track... (d) The TN is an active or inactive IU.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only J10.2 exception duplicates B:D032 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
(8)  JUs may apply one exception to the restriction in paragraphs 
4.4.4.3.1g(1) and 4.4.4.3.1g(7)(a) above.  If either subject track is the 
Target TN in a J10.2 Engagement Status message originated by the unit 
attempting correlation, and that track has an ID of Unknown or Hostile, and 
the other subject track has an ID of Friend, then automatic correlation may 
be allowed.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only new-local-track reporting/operator-release requirement duplicates B:D008 and B:D011 and is source-supported; split into the same confirmed rows.

evidence.quote: New local tracks shall not be reported to the interface until an automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on an initial correlation test or on the next test following an initial tentative correlation... If an operator action has been taken which selectively released a new local track for reporting, it shall be transmitted, regardless of the results of correlation testing.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only automatic correlation test triggers duplicate B:D006 and B:D007 and are source-supported; split into the same confirmed rows.

evidence.quote: (1) C2 JUs shall make an automatic correlation test either: (a) Upon receipt of each remote real-time J3.2 or J3.3 track or J2.0... J2.2, or J2.3 PPLI report which is not confirmed to have an existing correlation to a local track... ---OR--- (b) Immediately prior to each transmission of a local track.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only correlation test composition/timing duplicates B:D014 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote: Correlation testing shall consist of the position, velocity, and altitude tests specified in this paragraph... Positions of all tracks and IUs tested for correlation shall be extrapolated to the same time. The correlation test shall occur no more than 6 seconds after the extrapolation time.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only closest-track correlation match duplicates B:D014 and is source-supported; mapped to the same confirmed row.

evidence.quote:
A local track shall be 
considered to correlate to the closest remote track or IU that meets all of 
the correlation tests, subject to the correlation restrictions in paragraph
