evidence.quote: Emergency points may be related to a previously reported track/point.  In these cases the J3.1 message shall contain, as amplifying information, the TN, Previously Reported that is associated with the emergency point.

requirements.text: The emergency point shall have a TN, Reference different from the TN, Previously Reported.
requirements.conditions: ["J3.1 emergency point is related to a previously reported track or point."]

evidence.quote: The emergency point shall have a TN, Reference different from the TN, Previously Reported.

requirements.text: If the actual launcher is detected by sensors and is associated with a ballistic missile launch point, the C2 JU shall associate the launcher with the launch point using the J7.7 Association message.
requirements.conditions: ["Actual launcher is detected by sensors.","Actual launcher is associated with a launch point."]

evidence.quote: If the actual launcher is detected by sensors, a J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message shall be transmitted.  If the actual launcher is associated with a launch point, it shall be associated using the J7.7 Association message.

requirements.text: When it is determined that two TNs are being used to report information for the same target, the C2 JU shall use the J7.7 Track Association message to support a complete compilation of the subsurface situation.
requirements.conditions: ["Two TNs report information for the same subsurface target."]

evidence.quote: In order to provide for a complete compilation of the subsurface situation, the J7.7 Track Association message is used whenever it is determined that two Track Numbers (TNs) are being used to report information for the same target.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall report EW associations using the J7.7 message.

evidence.quote: EW association shall be reported using the J7.7 message.

requirements.text: A C2 JU may use J7.2 to correlate an EW AOP with a surveillance track, but shall not use J7.2 to correlate EW LOBs or fixes with surveillance tracks.

evidence.quote: The J7.2 message may be used to correlate EW AOPs with surveillance tracks, but shall not be used to correlate EW LOBs and fixes with surveillance tracks.

requirements.text: When an EW AOP can be correlated with a surveillance track, the C2 JU may transmit a J7.2 correlation message with the Retained TN set to the surveillance track TN and the Dropped TN set to the EW AOP TN.
requirements.conditions: ["EW AOP is known or suspected to be a detection of a surveillance track.","EW AOP can be correlated with the surveillance track."]

evidence.quote: If the EW AOP can be correlated with a surveillance track, a J7.2 correlation message may be transmitted with the Retained TN set to the TN of the track and the Dropped TN set to the TN of the EW AOP.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not use the J7.7 message to correlate two TNs or to pair a TN to any other TN.

evidence.quote: The J7.7 message shall not be used to correlate two TNs or to pair a TN to any other TN.

requirements.text: The C2 JU may transmit the J7.7 Association message concurrently with J6.0, J10.6, J7.2, or J10.2 messages because J7.7 is independent of those messages.

evidence.quote: The J7.7 message is totally independent of the J6.0, J10.6, J7.2, and J10.2 messages and may be transmitted concurrently with those messages.

requirements.text: The JU that originated an association shall terminate the association when it is determined that the association no longer exists.
requirements.conditions: ["Association no longer exists."]

evidence.quote: An association shall be terminated by the JU which had originated the association when it is determined that the association no longer exists.

requirements.text: Because the J7.7 message is transmitted periodically, JUs should purge received association data if the data have not been updated after a specified time; that time interval is optional.

evidence.quote: The J7.7 message is transmitted periodically and JUs should purge received data if data have not been updated after a specified time.  This time interval is optional.

requirements.text: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.

evidence.quote: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall use PPLI data available from J2 messages to reduce the redundancy of surveillance track reporting.

evidence.quote: PPLI data available from J2 messages shall be used by C2 JUs to reduce the redundancy of surveillance track reporting.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall accept PPLI information into its surveillance database and perform applicable correlation and conflict processing to ensure duplicative information is not transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence.quote: A surveillance JU will accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and perform the applicable correlation and conflict processing necessary to ensure that duplicative information is not being transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.

requirements.text: The C2 JU participating on the Surveillance Network PG shall attempt to correlate received PPLI reports with data being received from local sensors.

evidence.quote: A C2 JU participating on the Surveillance Network PG shall attempt to correlate received PPLI reports with data being received from local sensors.

requirements.text: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2, the C2 JU shall transmit the J7.2 Correlation message with the Response Value (RV) field set to value 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
requirements.conditions: ["Correlation found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2"]

evidence.quote: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2 the J7.2 Correlation message shall be transmitted with the Response Value (RV) field set to value 1 (Reverse Correlation Not Acceptable), and with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

requirements.text: If a correlation is found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2, the C2 JU shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN.
requirements.conditions: ["Correlation found with a track for which the C2 JU has R2"]

evidence.quote: The C2 JU shall cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message on the surveillance TN.

requirements.text: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the C2 JU shall transmit the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.
requirements.conditions: ["Correlation found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and TNs are different"]

evidence.quote: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are different, the J7.2 (RV = 1) Correlation message shall be transmitted, with the Source TN in the Header word of the J2 PPLI message as the Retained TN and the surveillance TN as the Dropped TN.

requirements.text: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same, the C2 JU shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0.
requirements.conditions: ["Correlation found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and TNs are the same"]

evidence.quote: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has R2 and the TNs are the same, the JU receiving the J2 shall accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specified track except when Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0

requirements.text: If Geodetic Position Quality in the PPLI message is set to value 0 during a correlation where TNs are the same and another C2 JU has R2, the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.
requirements.conditions: ["Geodetic Position Quality in PPLI is 0, TNs same, another C2 JU has R2"]

evidence.quote: in which case the surveillance track is accepted and the PPLI message shall be discarded.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall perform correlation and decorrelation of their local track data with respect to the remote data which they are receiving to ensure common tracking functions properly.

evidence.quote:
In order for common 
tracking to function properly, all C2 JUs shall perform correlation and 
decorrelation of their local track data with respect to the remote data which 
they are receiving.

requirements.text: The C2 JU which has a capability to originate and report real-time air, surface (maritime), land (ground), or space tracks shall have a capability to perform common tracking in accordance with the correlation and decorrelation procedures and criteria specified.
requirements.conditions: ["C2 JU has capability to originate and report real-time tracks"]

evidence.quote:
Each C2 JU which has a capability to originate and report real-time 
air, surface (maritime), land (ground), or space tracks shall have a 
capability to perform common tracking in accordance with the correlation and 
decorrelation procedures and criteria which follow.

requirements.text: All C2 JUs that originate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic correlation capability.
requirements.conditions: ["C2 JU originates real-time air or surface tracks"]

evidence.quote:
All C2 JUs that originate 
real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic correlation 
capability.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not report new local tracks to the interface until an automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on an initial correlation test or on the next test following an initial tentative correlation.
requirements.conditions: ["New local track initiated"]

evidence.quote:
New local tracks shall not be reported to the 
interface until an automatic correlation has been attempted and failed on an 
initial correlation test or on the next test following an initial tentative 
correlation

requirements.text: If no tentative correlation is found on the initial test, the C2 JU shall transmit the new local track.
requirements.conditions: ["No tentative correlation on initial test"]

evidence.quote:
If no tentative correlation is found 
on the initial test, the new local track shall be transmitted.

requirements.text: If the new local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation on the next test, the C2 JU shall transmit the new local track.
requirements.conditions: ["Tentative correlation on initial test, fail on next test"]

evidence.quote:
If the new 
local track tentatively correlates on the initial test but fails correlation 
on the next test, the new local track shall be transmitted.

requirements.text: A new local track that correlates with another track on each of the first two correlation tests shall be correlated and held as a common local track.
requirements.conditions: ["Correlates on first two tests"]

evidence.quote:
A new local 
track that correlates with another track on each of the first two correlation 
tests shall be correlated and held as a common local track.

requirements.text: If an operator action has been taken which selectively released a new local track for reporting, the C2 JU shall transmit it, regardless of the results of correlation testing.
requirements.conditions: ["Operator action selectively released new local track"]

evidence.quote:
If an operator action has been taken which selectively 
released a new local track for reporting, it shall be transmitted, regardless 
of the results of correlation testing.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall make an automatic correlation test either upon receipt of each remote real-time J3.2 or J3.3 track or J2.0, J2.2, or J2.3 PPLI report which is not confirmed to have an existing correlation to a local track, OR immediately prior to each transmission of a local track.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs shall make an automatic correlation test either: (a) Upon receipt of each remote real-time J3.2 or J3.3 track or J2.0 (Originator E/C = 0 or 3), J2.2, or J2.3 PPLI report which is not confirmed to have an existing correlation to a local track... ---OR--- (b) Immediately prior to each transmission of a local track.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall provide a manual capability to initiate the correlation of any two tracks irrespective of correlation test criteria, restrictions, or requirements, except that two tracks shall not be manually correlated if they are of a different E/C, or one is simulated and the other is live, or both are remote.

evidence.quote:
A manual capability shall be provided to 
initiate the correlation of any two tracks irrespective of the correlation 
test criteria in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1f, the correlation restrictions in 
paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g, or the requirements in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1h, except 
that two tracks shall not be manually correlated if they are of a different 
E/C, or one is simulated and the other is live, or both are remote.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall perform correlation tests in response to correlation requests from other units in accordance with the requirements of paragraph 4.7.3.2.
requirements.conditions: ["Receipt of correlation request"]

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs shall perform correlation 
tests in response to correlation requests from other units in accordance with 
the requirements of paragraph 4.7.3.2.

requirements.text: Correlation testing shall consist of the position, velocity, and altitude tests specified, and positions of all tracks and IUs tested for correlation shall be extrapolated to the same time.

evidence.quote: Correlation testing shall consist of the position, velocity, and altitude tests specified in this paragraph... Positions of all tracks and IUs tested for correlation shall be extrapolated to the same time.

requirements.text: The correlation test shall occur no more than 6 seconds after the extrapolation time.

evidence.quote:
The correlation test shall occur no 
more than 6 seconds after the extrapolation time.

requirements.text: A local track shall be considered to correlate to the closest remote track or IU that meets all of the correlation tests, subject to correlation restrictions and the requirement to pass two correlation tests.

evidence.quote:
A local track shall be 
considered to correlate to the closest remote track or IU that meets all of 
the correlation tests, subject to the correlation restrictions in paragraph 
4.4.4.3.1g and the requirement to pass two correlation tests in paragraph 
4.4.4.3.1h.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not test for correlation a track with TQ less than or equal to the restricted TQ value e, or a JU with Qpg = 0, except this prohibition does not apply to new local real-time tracks.

evidence.quote: The following shall not be tested for correlation: (a) A track with TQ ≤ e ... or a JU with Qpg = 0 ... This prohibition does not apply to new local real-time tracks, but does apply to nonreal-time (TQ=0) tracks.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not test for correlation tracks of different E/C, and tracks with existing E/C conflicts.

evidence.quote:
(b)  Tracks of different E/C, and tracks with existing E/C 
conflicts.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not test for correlation simulated tracks with live tracks, and live tracks with simulated tracks.

evidence.quote:
(c)  Simulated tracks with live tracks, and live tracks 
with simulated tracks.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall be capable of using any value within the specified range and increments for variable correlation parameters upon system initialization, and shall set the parameter to the default value if no other value is specified.

evidence.quote:
Systems 
shall be capable of using any value within the specified range and increments 
upon system initialization, and shall set the parameter to the default value 
if no other value is specified.

requirements.text: Two tracks shall be eligible for correlation if they pass the positional test D ≤ [a*SQRT(L2 + R2) + b] dm, subject to other tests, prohibitions, and limitations.

evidence.quote: Two tracks shall be eligible for correlation, subject to the other tests, prohibitions, and limitations of this paragraph, if they pass the following positional test: D ≤ [a*SQRT(L2 + R2) + b] dm

requirements.text: Tracks with TQ less than or equal to the restricted TQ value e shall not be automatically correlated.

evidence.quote:
Tracks with TQ less than or equal to the 
restricted TQ value e shall not be automatically correlated, since their 
positional accuracy is not sufficient to support valid correlation decisions.

requirements.text: TQs less than c shall be treated the same as TQ c, and TQs greater than d shall be treated the same as d, for purposes of calculating D, the correlation window.

evidence.quote:
Therefore, TQs less than c shall be treated the same as TQ c, and TQs greater 
than d shall be treated the same as d, for purposes of calculating D, the 
correlation window.

requirements.text: The reported course of the remote track shall be within f degrees of the calculated course of the local track for the velocity test, provided both tracks have speed ≥ 10 dmh.
requirements.conditions: ["Both tracks have speed ≥ 10 dmh"]

evidence.quote:
Course Test 
If both tracks have speed ≥ 10 dmh: 
 
    MIN(|CR-CL|, 360-|CR-CL|) ≤ f

The reported course of the remote track 
shall be within f degrees of the calculated course of the local track.

requirements.text: The speed of the slower track shall be within g percent of the speed of the faster track, or within g*200/SF percent for air tracks or g*20/SF percent for surface tracks, whichever is greater.

evidence.quote:
The 
speed of the slower track shall be within g percent of the speed of the 
faster track, or within g*200/SF percent for air tracks or g*20/SF percent for 
surface tracks, whichever is greater.

requirements.text: Velocity comparisons shall use the last reported course and speed of remote tracks and the course and speed calculated for local tracks at the common time to which the tracks are extrapolated at the time of comparison.

evidence.quote:
Velocity comparisons shall use the last 
reported course and speed of remote tracks and the course and speed 
calculated for local tracks at the common time to which the tracks are 
extrapolated at the time of comparison.

requirements.text: If the Altitude Source of both air tracks is either 1 (Sensor) or 3 (Aircraft Automatic Altitude Report), or if the local track Altitude Source is 1 or 3 and the remote track is an IU reported in a PPLI message, the altitude differential between the two tracks shall not be greater than h.
requirements.conditions: ["Altitude Source conditions met"]

evidence.quote:
If the Altitude Source of both air tracks is 
either 1 (Sensor) or 3 (Aircraft Automatic Altitude Report), or if the local 
track Altitude Source is 1 or 3 and the remote track is an IU reported in a 
PPLI message, the altitude differential between the two tracks shall not be 
greater than h.

requirements.text: If the Altitude Source of either track is 0 (No Statement/Estimated) or 2 (Aircraft Report), Altitude shall not be used in the correlation test.
requirements.conditions: ["Altitude Source is 0 or 2"]

evidence.quote:
If the Altitude Source of either track is 0 (No 
Statement/Estimated) or 2 (Aircraft Report), Altitude shall not be used in 
the correlation test.

requirements.text: When the remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.2 Air or J2.3 Surface PPLI message, the maximum positional error associated with the reported Geodetic Position Quality (Qpg) shall be used for the value of R in the position test.
requirements.conditions: ["Remote report is J2.2 or J2.3 PPLI"]

evidence.quote:
When the remote report being tested for correlation is 
a J2.2 Air or J2.3 Surface PPLI message, the maximum positional error

the value of R in the position test.

requirements.text: Qpg less than j shall be treated as Qpg = j, and Qpg greater than k shall be treated as Qpg = k for PPLI correlation tests.

evidence.quote:
Qpg less than j shall be treated as Qpg = 
j, and Qpg greater than k shall be treated as Qpg = k.

requirements.text: If the received J2.2 or J2.3 Qpg = 0, the PPLI shall not be correlated automatically.

evidence.quote:
If the received J2.2 or J2.3 Qpg = 0, the PPLI shall

evidence.quote: However, if a J2.2 or J2.3 with Qpg = 0 is received for a JU held as a common local track, R2 for the common local track may be assumed in accordance with paragraph 4.4.2.2.2d.

requirements.text: When the remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), it shall be processed for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.
requirements.conditions: ["Remote report is J2.0 Indirect PPLI with Originator E/C 0 or 3"]

evidence.quote:
When the remote report being tested for correlation is 
a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0

or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.

requirements.text: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the specified correlation restrictions exist (ID conflict, Mode II conflict, both local real-time, Strength > 1, common local/remote same R2, dual designation resolution in progress, OCCs).

evidence.quote:
C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate 
two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the following

requirements.text: The correlation restrictions do not apply to manual correlation.

No

Systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength

evidence.quote:

evidence.quote: The Unknown/Hostile track shall be the dropped Track Number (TN-2).

evidence.quote:
This exception shall not be applied by any JU upon

evidence.quote:
Two tracks shall pass the correlation 
tests and restrictions in paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1f and 4.4.4.3.1g 2(1-2,1) times

When two tracks pass the correlation

evidence.quote:

scope.goal: Coordinate Link 16 surveillance transmit/data filters for a C2 JU, including coordination, receive-to-transmit filter mirroring, filter effects and exceptions, and J7.6/J7.1 management messages.
scope.start_boundary: When a C2 JU establishes, activates, reports, requests, deletes, or coordinates data filters that inhibit surveillance data transmission, or when it filters surveillance tracks or IUs on receipt.
scope.success_boundary: Surveillance transmit filters are coordinated and implemented so eligible data is inhibited or terminated as specified, protected data and messages are not filtered, and filter management/status is requested or reported using the prescribed Link 16 messages and procedures.
in_scope: Coordination of interface/data filters with other IUs
Receive filters and corresponding transmit filters
Transmit-filter applicability to surveillance tracks, reference points, EW product information, and targets
Filter exceptions for alerts, emergency points, active C2 IUs, and J7.2 correlation messages
Filter activation effects on existing and future tracks
J7.6 filter implementation, description, and deletion messages
J7.1 filter information requests
Moving transmit filters
Filter numbering and coordination
Separation of message label/sublabel filters from data filters
out_of_scope: General J3 surveillance track reporting unrelated to filtering
NonC2 JU use of Surveillance NPG
R2 correlation algorithms except where filter activation requires termination or R2-related handling
Detailed J3.6 covariance encoding
Weapon, mission, PPLI, or platform status procedures not invoked by filter management

evidence.quote: Data filters may be used to inhibit the flow of data on a data link. A data filter that inhibits data from being transmitted on a data link is a transmit filter.
The data filtering rules at sub-paragraphs a. through i. below apply to C2 JUs
Management and reporting of Link 16 transmit filters are accomplished using the following messages:

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall coordinate the use of interface filters with all IUs to minimize track management problems; coordination of filtering requests may be performed by voice or other communications media.

evidence.quote: The use of interface filters shall be coordinated with all IUs to minimize track management problems. Coordination of filtering requests may be done by voice or other communications media.

requirements.text: When a receive filter is geographically defined, the corresponding transmit filter shall, where possible, be defined to permit the area filtered for transmission to be slightly larger than the area filtered for reception so that tracks entering or leaving the filtered area may be displayed to the operator to prevent dual designations.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"The receive filter is geographically defined","result":"Define the transmit-filter area slightly larger where possible"}]

evidence.quote: when a receive filter is geographically defined, the transmit filter must, where possible, be defined to permit the area filtered for transmission to be slightly larger than the area filtered for reception so that tracks entering or leaving the filtered area may be displayed to the operator to prevent dual designations.

requirements.text: If a C2 JU's storage files are filled and all applicable filters have been used, the C2 JU shall not be required to accept new data regardless of its ID or priority; this applies to both real-time and nonreal-time data.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"Storage files are full and all applicable filters have been used","result":"Acceptance of new data is not required"}]

evidence.quote: If the storage files of a JU are filled and all applicable filters have been used, acceptance of the new data shall not be required, regardless of its ID or priority. This procedure applies to both real-time and nonreal-time data.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not filter any track or nonC2 IU with the Emergency Indicator or Force Tell Indicator set to value 1.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"EMG IND or FT IND is set to 1 on a track or nonC2 IU","result":"The track or nonC2 IU is not filtered"}]

evidence.quote: Any track or nonC2 IU with an EMG IND or FT IND set to the value of 1 shall not be filtered.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not filter a J3.1 message.

evidence.quote: A J3.1 message shall not be filtered.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not filter active nonsimulated C2 IUs; C2 IUs with the Simulation Indicator set in their J2 PPLI message may be filtered.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"The C2 IU is active and nonsimulated","result":"The C2 IU cannot be filtered"},{"condition":"The C2 IU has the Simulation Indicator set in its J2 PPLI message","result":"The C2 IU may be filtered"}]

evidence.quote: Active nonsimulated C2 IUs cannot be filtered. In other words, C2 IUs with the Simulation Indicator field set in their J2 PPLI message may be filtered.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall identify all filters by filter number for coordination with other JUs.

evidence.quote: All filters are identified by filter number for coordination with other JUs.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall make a track eligible for transmission on the interface only if the track is not inhibited from transmission by any currently set transmission filter.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"A track is inhibited by any currently set transmit filter","result":"The track is not eligible for transmission"}]

evidence.quote: Tracks are eligible for transmission on the interface only if they are not inhibited from transmission by any of the transmission filters currently set.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall apply filters to tracks initiated before filter activation and to tracks initiated while the filter is active.

evidence.quote: Filters shall apply to tracks initiated prior to filter activation as well as to tracks initiated while the filter is active.

requirements.text: When a C2 JU activates a transmit filter, it shall cease reporting any track for which it has R2 and which meets the filter criteria, and shall comply with the rules for terminating transmission of the applicable track data of the applicable Environment/Category.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"A transmit filter is activated and an R2 track meets the filter criteria","result":"Cease reporting and follow applicable track-data termination rules"}]

evidence.quote: When a transmit filter is activated by a unit, the unit shall cease reporting any track for which it has R2 and which meets the filter criteria, and shall comply with the rules for terminating transmission of the applicable track data of the applicable Environment/Category.

requirements.text: No filter shall inhibit the J7.2 Correlation message.

evidence.quote: The J7.2 Correlation message shall not be inhibited by any filter.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall manage and report Link 16 transmit filters using J7.6 (ACT = 0) Filter Implementation Request, J7.6 (ACT = 1) Filter Description Report, J7.6 (ACT = 2) Delete Filter Request/Report, and J7.1 (ACT = 0) Data Update Request by Request Indicator messages.

evidence.quote: Management and reporting of Link 16 transmit filters are accomplished using the following messages: a. J7.6 (ACT = 0) Filter Implementation Request message. b. J7.6 (ACT = 1) Filter Description Report message. c. J7.6 (ACT = 2) Delete Filter Request/Report message. d. J7.1 (ACT = 0) Data Update Request by Request Indicator message.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall use the J7.6 message only for transmit filters, including data forwarding filters, and not to request or report receive filters.

evidence.quote: The J7.6 message only applies to transmit filters as defined in paragraph 4.7.7, i.e., it is only used to request or report the insertion or deletion of transmit filters including data forwarding filters.
The use of receive filters is neither requested nor reported via Link 16.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall use the Filter Unit Type field to indicate whether a filter applies to individual JU transmissions or forwarding unit transmissions of forwarded data.

evidence.quote: The Filter Unit Type field indicates whether the filter applies to individual JU transmissions or forwarding unit transmissions of forwarded data.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not request or report forwarding-unit filters for filtering transmissions from any link other than Link 16 into Link 16.

evidence.quote: Forwarding unit filters requested or reported are only those used for filtering transmissions originating on Link 16. Filters for forwarding data from any other link to Link 16 are neither requested nor reported via Link 16.

requirements.text: In addition to the filter message, a C2 JU shall use voice coordination to ensure filter management on the interface.

target.name: Decorrelate Diverging Air or Surface Tracks

scope.goal: Specify how a C2 JU recognizes and executes decorrelation of diverging real-time air or surface tracks held as common local tracks, including reporting the local track under a new track number and handling related operational constraints.
scope.start_boundary: When a C2 JU that initiates real-time air or surface tracks is holding a common local track and receives a J2 or J3 message on that track, it performs automatic decorrelation testing.
scope.success_boundary: A common local track meeting the decorrelation criteria is decorrelated: it is tested once for correlation against remote tracks, assigned and reported with a new TN if correlation fails, the prior TN is established as a remote track, and applicable engagement, command, control, pairing, Index Number, or handover constraints are handled.
in_scope: Common tracking decorrelation for real-time air tracks and surface (maritime) tracks
Automatic and manual decorrelation capabilities
Automatic decorrelation tests upon receipt of J2 or J3 messages for common local tracks
Consecutive-report threshold and distance criterion for decorrelation
Single correlation test before assigning a new track number during decorrelation execution
Reporting the decorrelated local track in J3.2 or J3.3 with initial Pending identity
Establishing the original track number as a remote track
Required actions or alerts for engagements, pending commands, own-unit control, pairing, Index Numbers, and in-progress handovers
out_of_scope: Subsurface track correlation or decorrelation procedures
Land or space track decorrelation, except general common-tracking capability text that also names those track types
Electronic Warfare product information correlation or termination
Generic track quality algorithms unrelated to decorrelation
Message-specific initial transmission redundancy rules in Section 5
NonC2 JU use of the Surveillance NPG

evidence.quote: In order for common tracking to function properly, all C² JUs shall perform correlation and decorrelation of their local track data with respect to the remote data which they are receiving.
The rules in paragraphs 4.4.4.3.1, 4.4.4.3.2, and 4.7.3 apply to the correlation and decorrelation of both air tracks and surface tracks, unless otherwise stated.

All C2 JUs that initiate real-time air or surface tracks shall have an automatic decorrelation capability. C2 JUs may also perform manual decorrelation, and may have a capability to require manual confirmation of automatic decorrelations.
Automatic decorrelation tests shall be performed for each common local track upon receipt of each J2 or J3 message on the track.

If the automatic correlation test fails, assign a new TN (TN B) to the local track and report TN B in a J3.2 or J3.3 message, with an initial ID of Pending. For manual decorrelation the Pending ID may be overridden by operator action.

target.name: Initiate and Clear Surveillance Track Alerts

scope.goal: Initiate and Clear Surveillance Track Alerts
scope.start_boundary: When a surveillance track requires emergency or force tell alert status, or when a C2 JU receives a track alert status change to process
scope.success_boundary: When the appropriate emergency or force tell indicator is set or cleared in the applicable J3 track message or J7.0 status change message, and receiving JUs accept or terminate the alert in their databases
in_scope: Initiating force tell alerts on surveillance tracks by JUs with R²
Initiating emergency alerts on surveillance tracks by JUs with R²
Terminating force tell alerts on surveillance tracks by JUs with R²
Terminating emergency alerts on surveillance tracks by JUs with R²
Initiating or terminating track alerts by JUs without R² using J7.0 status change messages
Receiving JU acceptance and database termination of track alerts
Propagation of track alert indicators when another JU assumes R²
out_of_scope: Alerts for reference points, lines, or areas
Alerts for J3.1 emergency points
Alerts for land points or subsurface contacts governed by the separate paragraph 4.7.1.4.6 procedures
Alerts for EW Product information
Alerts for participating or reporting units in J2 messages
General surveillance transmission requirements unrelated to alert indicators
Filter management procedures except where the alert itself requires non-filterability

evidence.quote: 4.7.1.4.5  ALERT INDICATORS FOR TRACKS

A JU with R2 shall initiate an emergency or force tell alert on tracks by 
setting the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in the J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface 
(Maritime) Track, J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track, or J3.5 Land (Ground) 
Point/Track message.  All receiving JUs shall accept the alert in their 
databases.

The JU with R2 shall terminate an emergency or force tell alert by 
transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message terminating the alert and setting 
the appropriate EMG IND field or FT IND field in subsequent J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, 
or J3.5 messages to 0.  All receiving JUs shall terminate the alert in their 
databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.

A JU without R2 shall initiate/terminate an emergency or force tell alert by 
setting/clearing the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) 
message.  Upon receipt, the JU with R2 shall set/clear the appropriate EMG IND 
or FT IND in the J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message.  Other receiving JUs 
without R2 shall set/clear the appropriate EMG IND or FT IND in their 
databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.

scope.goal: Publish Ballistic Missile Surveillance Reports on the Link 16 interface, including ballistic missile tracks/points, related launch/impact point handling, correlation, positional/velocity/covariance/identity/TQ/lost-track/time behavior, R2 gating, update responses, and termination.
scope.start_boundary: When a C2 JU detects or holds an established local ballistic missile track/point and determines whether it can be correlated with a remote track/point and whether it has reporting responsibility.
scope.success_boundary: The C2 JU publishes only eligible, properly formatted and time-tagged ballistic missile surveillance reports while it has R2, with required correlation, data content, alert/termination, and reporting-responsibility rules satisfied.
in_scope: J3.6 Space Track reports for ballistic missile tracks
J3.0 launch and impact point reports related to ballistic missiles
ballistic missile track/point reporting criteria
ballistic missile correlation and dual designation minimization
position, velocity, covariance, identity, track quality, lost track, and time requirements
ballistic missile reporting responsibility
data update request responses for ballistic missile data
termination and purging of ballistic missile track data
out_of_scope: NonC2 JU behavior as publisher on Surveillance NPG
general air, surface, land, subsurface, or EW surveillance rules except where explicitly applied to ballistic missiles
receiver-only filtering behavior not specific to publishing ballistic missile reports
detailed bit-level word encoding beyond the source’s stated covariance and message requirements

evidence.quote: 4.4.6  SPACE AND BALLISTIC MISSILE SURVEILLANCE
Ballistic Missile surveillance tracks.  The various requirements associated
JUs reporting Ballistic Missile surveillance information on the interface shall ensure the following:
The J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track for which it currently has R2

requirements.text: A C2 JU reporting ballistic missile surveillance information shall ensure the information on each ballistic missile track/point is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.

evidence.quote: The information on the ballistic missile track/point is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.

requirements.text: A C2 JU reporting ballistic missile surveillance information shall ensure data are correlated and dual designation is minimized.

evidence.quote: Data are correlated and dual designation is minimized.

requirements.text: A C2 JU reporting ballistic missile surveillance information shall follow the proper rules for reporting a ballistic missile track/point.

evidence.quote: The proper rules for reporting a ballistic missile track/point are followed.

requirements.text: When publishing ballistic missile track/point data, a C2 JU shall provide the source of the data as Source TN.

evidence.quote: The source of ballistic missile track/point data shall be provided (Source TN).

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall time tag ballistic missile data.

evidence.quote: Ballistic missile data shall be time tagged.

requirements.text: If a friendly interceptor missile track is reported and the missile is capable only of endoatmospheric intercepts, the C2 JU shall report it using the J3.2 Air Track message.
requirements.conditions: If reported and capable only of endoatmospheric intercepts

evidence.quote: friendly interceptor missile tracks shall be reported on the interface using the J3.2 Air Track message for missiles capable only of endoatmospheric intercepts

requirements.text: If a friendly interceptor missile track is reported and the interceptor is capable of exoatmospheric intercepts, the C2 JU shall report it using the J3.6 Space Track message.
requirements.conditions: If reported and capable of exoatmospheric intercepts

evidence.quote: and the J3.6 Space Track message for
interceptors capable of exoatmospheric intercepts.

requirements.text: When reporting an interceptor missile in a J3.2 message, a C2 JU shall report Platform and Platform Activity.
requirements.conditions: When reporting an interceptor missile in J3.2

evidence.quote: When reporting an interceptor missile in the J3.2 message, Platform and Platform Activity shall be reported.

requirements.text: A C2 JU with R2 of a ballistic missile track shall maintain R2 on the related Impact Point.
requirements.conditions: When it has R2 of the ballistic missile track

evidence.quote: A JU with R² of a ballistic missile track shall maintain R² on the related Impact Point.

requirements.text: Upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report for a ballistic missile, the C2 JU with R2 of the Launch Point or Impact Point shall transmit the Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages with Connect/Disconnect set to value 1, Disconnect.
requirements.conditions: Upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report for a ballistic missile

evidence.quote: the JU with R² of the Launch Point or Impact Point shall transmit the Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages with the Connect/Disconnect field set to value 1, Disconnect.

requirements.text: After disconnecting a related Impact Point or Launch Point, a C2 JU shall transmit any subsequent reports of that point with Related 2 Track Number of J3.0C5 set to value 0, No Statement.
requirements.conditions: For subsequent reports after disconnect

evidence.quote: Any subsequent reports of the Impact Point or Launch Point shall be transmitted with the Related 2 Track Number field Of the J3.0C5 message set to value 0, No Statement.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not transmit an initial surveillance report on a ballistic missile if the predicted time to impact is less than 16 seconds.
requirements.conditions: Predicted time to impact < 16 seconds

evidence.quote: A JU shall not transmit an initial surveillance report on a ballistic missile if the predicted time to impact is less than 16 seconds.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall use the J3.0 Reference Point message to report the actual or expected Launch Point of a ballistic missile.

evidence.quote: The J3.0 Reference Point message is used to report the actual or expected Launch Point of a ballistic missile.

requirements.text: A C2 JU reporting a missile launch shall report the launch time to the nearest second with Time Function set to value 4, Departure Time.

evidence.quote: The time of the launch is reported to the nearest second with the Time Function field set to value 4, Departure Time.

requirements.text: For an early-warning indication of expected launch, a C2 JU shall set Time Function to Departure Time and set Hour, Minute, and Second either to No Statement or to the expected launch time.
requirements.conditions: For an early-warning indication of expected launch

evidence.quote: An early warning indication of an expected launch shall be reported by setting the Time Function field to Departure Time and setting the Hour, Minute, and Second fields to either No Statement or to the expected time of launch.

requirements.text: If a missile launch point is related to a specific ballistic missile track, a C2 JU shall identify that track in the J3.0C5 Related 2 Track Number field.
requirements.conditions: When a launch point is related to a specific ballistic missile track

evidence.quote: If a missile launch point is related to a specific ballistic missile track it shall be identified in the J3.0C5 Related 2 Track Number field.

requirements.text: If the actual launcher is detected by sensors, a C2 JU shall transmit a J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message.
requirements.conditions: When the actual launcher is detected by sensors

evidence.quote: If the actual launcher is detected by sensors, a J3.2, J3.3, J3.4, or J3.5 message shall be transmitted.

requirements.text: If the actual launcher is associated with a launch point, a C2 JU shall associate it using the J7.7 Association message.
requirements.conditions: When the actual launcher is associated with a launch point

evidence.quote: If the actual launcher is associated with a launch point, it shall be associated using the J7.7 Association message.

requirements.text: A C2 JU originating a J3.0 Ballistic Missile Launch Point retains R2 as long as it remains active and reports the point.
requirements.conditions: Originator remains active and reports the point

evidence.quote: The originator of a J3.0 Ballistic Missile Launch Point retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point.

requirements.text: The latest IU to report on a ballistic missile launch point has R2 for the point.

evidence.quote: The latest IU to report on a ballistic missile launch point has R2 for the point.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall use the J3.0 Reference Point message to report the actual or expected Impact Point of a ballistic missile.

evidence.quote: The J3.0 Reference Point message is used to report the actual or expected Impact Point of a ballistic missile.

requirements.text: If the warhead type is known, a C2 JU shall report it in the J3.0C5 Space Amplification field and report a measure of certainty in Amplification Confidence.
requirements.conditions: If warhead type is known

evidence.quote: The type of warhead, if known, shall be reported in the J3.0C5 Space Amplification field with a measure of the certainty reported in the Amplification Confidence field.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall report the actual or expected time of impact to the nearest second with Time Function set to value 3, Arrival Time.

evidence.quote: The actual or expected time of impact is reported to the nearest second with the Time Function field set to value 3, Arrival Time.

requirements.text: For a pre-launch indication of an expected Impact Point, a C2 JU shall set Time Function to Arrival Time and Hour, Minute, and Second either to No Statement or to the expected impact time.
requirements.conditions: For a pre-launch indication

evidence.quote: A pre-launch indication of an expected Impact Point shall be reported by setting the Time Function field to Arrival Time and the Hour, Minute, and Second fields to either No Statement or to the expected time of impact.

requirements.text: If an Impact Point is related to a specific ballistic missile track, a C2 JU shall identify that track in the J3.0C5 Related 2 Track Number field.
requirements.conditions: When Impact Point is related to a specific missile track

evidence.quote: If the Impact point is related to a specific ballistic missile track it shall be identified in the J3.0C5 Related 2 Track Number field.

requirements.text: A related TN for an Impact Point shall be used only by the C2 JU with R2 for the related missile track, and a change in R2 of the ballistic missile track shall cause a change in R2 for the related Impact Point.

evidence.quote: A related TN for Impact Point will be used only by the C2 JU with R2 for the related missile track.  Therefore a change in R2 of the ballistic missile track also causes a change in R2 for the related Impact Point.

requirements.text: A C2 JU is not required to continue transmitting a missile impact point after predicted impact.
requirements.conditions: After predicted impact

evidence.quote: There is no requirement to continue transmitting a missile impact point after predicted impact.

requirements.text: The probability estimate for ballistic missile launch/impact point location accuracy shall include the effects of measurement errors, systematic errors, and known maneuvering capabilities used to project launch or impact points.

evidence.quote: The Probability estimate shall include the effects of measurement errors, systematic errors, and known maneuvering capabilities used to project launch or impact points.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall continuously correlate locally derived ballistic missile tracks with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG.

evidence.quote: each C2 JU must continuously correlate locally derived ballistic missile tracks with ballistic missile tracks reported on the Surveillance NPG.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall report all uncorrelated local ballistic missile tracks and assume R2 for those tracks in accordance with the ballistic missile R2 rules.

evidence.quote: Each C2 JU shall report on all uncorrelated local ballistic missile tracks and shall assume R2 for those tracks in accordance with the R2 rules as specified in paragraph 4.4.6.15.

requirements.text: In the event of conflict between locally derived information and reported ballistic missile information, a C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
requirements.conditions: When a conflict exists

evidence.quote: In the event of conflict, the C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall report positional data for ballistic missile tracks in the Space Track message as X, Y, Z position in earth-centered, earth-fixed Cartesian coordinates defined by WGS-84.

evidence.quote: The positional data for ballistic missile tracks are reported in the Space Track message as X, Y, Z position in earth-centered, earth-fixed (ECF) Cartesian coordinates defined by the World Geodetic System-84 (WGS-84) Reference Frame.

requirements.text: When reported, ballistic missile covariance data shall include the best estimate of both tracking errors and statistical estimates of biases produced by emplacement errors, alignment errors, and other systematic errors.
requirements.conditions: When covariance data are reported

evidence.quote: When reported, ballistic missile covariance data shall include the best estimate of both tracking errors and statistical estimates of biases produced by emplacement errors, alignment errors, and other systematic errors.

requirements.text: Instead of transmitting the covariance matrix directly, a C2 JU shall transmit ballistic missile covariance data using root variances of the covariance matrix and elements of the Cholesky decomposition of the precompensated correlation matrix.
requirements.conditions: When transmitting covariance data

evidence.quote: Instead of transmitting the covariance matrix directly, ballistic missile covariance data shall be transmitted with the root variances of the covariance matrix and elements of the Cholesky decomposition of the precompensated correlation matrix

requirements.text: The covariance matrix P shall be a symmetric, positive definite matrix such that the track error is within the specified six-dimensional ellipsoid with probability no less than 95 percent.

evidence.quote: Then P shall be a symmetric, positive definite matrix such that the track error is within the following six-dimensional ellipsoid with probability no less than 95 percent:

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall exchange ballistic missile identity as defined in the standard identity rules.

evidence.quote: Ballistic Missile identity is exchanged as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1.

requirements.text: Operational Commander-defined values within the Space Specific Type field shall be defined at initialization via OPTASK LINK.

evidence.quote: Operational Commander defined values within the Space Specific Type field are defined at initialization via the OPTASK LINK.

requirements.text: When the JU with R2 receives no local sensor data after the last transmitted update or determines by other system criteria that the track is lost, subsequent reports shall include data held at the time of last sensor contact and set Lost Track Indicator to value 1, Lost Track.
requirements.conditions: When the ballistic missile track is lost

evidence.quote: A ballistic missile track is considered lost when the JU with R2 does not receive any local sensor data since the last transmitted update, or the JU determines that the track is lost by other system criteria.  Subsequent reports on the ballistic missile track will include data held at the time of last sensor contact, and the Lost Track Indicator field will be set to value 1, Lost Track.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall not extrapolate ballistic missile track data except as specified for time tagging and referenced-time processing.

evidence.quote: Ballistic missile track data will not be extrapolated except as specified in accordance with paragraph 4.4.6.13.

requirements.text: A C2 JU must be prepared to accept ballistic missile data that may have time fields set to future values.

evidence.quote: Systems must be prepared to accept data that may have time fields set to future values.

requirements.text: The first JU to report a ballistic missile track has R2 on that track.

evidence.quote: The first JU to report the ballistic missile track has R2 on that track.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall transmit a ballistic missile track report only when it has R2 for that track.

evidence.quote: A JU transmits a track report for a ballistic missile only when it has R2 for that track.

requirements.text: A C2 JU with R2 for a nonreal-time ballistic missile track shall relinquish R2 upon receiving a remote real-time track report for that track.
requirements.conditions: On receipt of a remote real-time report

evidence.quote: A JU with R2 for a nonreal-time ballistic missile track will relinquish R2 upon receiving a remote real-time track report for that track.

requirements.text: A C2 JU assumes R2 if it has not received a remote report on a locally held track for 25 seconds, but only when the last remote report had Lost Track Indicator set to value 0, Tracking.
requirements.conditions: No remote report for 25 seconds and last report was Tracking

evidence.quote: A JU assumes R2 if it has not received a remote report on a locally held track for 25 seconds.  This rule only applies when the last remote report was received with Lost Track Indicator set to value 0, Tracking.

requirements.text: A C2 JU receiving a J7.0 Drop Track Report on a locally held track shall assume R2 at the next transmission opportunity if local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received.
requirements.conditions: Receipt of J7.0 Drop Track Report with eligibility and no remote report

evidence.quote: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R2 at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.

requirements.text: A C2 JU without R2 for a nonreal-time track shall assume R2 when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report; the time value is not a criterion for an R2 shift.
requirements.conditions: Locally updated by a new nonreal-time report

evidence.quote: A JU without R2 for a nonreal-time track, i.e., TQ field set to value 0, shall assume R2 for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.  A JU reporting a nonreal-time track has R2 regardless of the time value in the track report.  The time value in a nonreal-time report is not a criterion for an R2 shift.

requirements.text: A C2 JU with R2 retains the responsibility until it is relinquished under the R2 rules or the track is dropped.

evidence.quote: A JU with R2 on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.

requirements.text: A unit assuming R2 for a ballistic missile track need not assume R2 for the associated launch point, and the unit no longer holding R2 on the missile track may continue reporting the launch point under transmit/receive rules.

evidence.quote: A unit assuming R2 for a ballistic missile track need not assume R2 for the associated launch point.  The unit no longer holding R2 on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall resolve Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Environment/Category differences by transmitting the appropriate J7 message under paragraph 4.7.
requirements.conditions: When such differences are detected

evidence.quote: Detection and resolution of Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Environment/Category differences are resolved by transmitting the appropriate J7 message. The specific procedures applicable to the resolution of those differences are discussed in paragraph 4.7, Information Management.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall transmit J7.0 Drop Track Report when it ceases reporting a ballistic missile track for which it currently has R2, except when it ceases reporting because it has relinquished R2 to another JU.
requirements.conditions: Ceases reporting and currently has R2

evidence.quote: The J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track for which it currently has R2, except when a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU.

requirements.text: When a system purges a remote ballistic missile track after receiving no Drop Track Report and no further updates, it shall not transmit a J7.0 Drop Track Report.
requirements.conditions: Remote ballistic missile track is purged locally

evidence.quote: There may be cases when a system does not receive a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, and receives no further updates on the remote ballistic missile track.

requirements.text: The C2 JU with R2 for a Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 Ballistic Missile Update Request on a specific TN and shall transmit the data held in the appropriate J3.6 word sequence.
requirements.conditions: Receipt of J7.1 ACT=2 on a specific TN

evidence.quote: The C2 JU with R2 for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.  The JU shall transmit the data held in the appropriate J3.6 word sequence.

requirements.text: A NonR2 JU shall not respond to a J7.1 ACT=2 Ballistic Missile Update Request.
requirements.conditions: Actor lacks R2

evidence.quote: NonR2 JUs shall not respond to a J7.1 (ACT = 2) Ballistic Missile Update Request.

requirements.text: If an R2 shift occurs during execution of a ballistic missile DUR response with Number/Frequency of Updates set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R2 shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.
requirements.conditions: R2 shift during a DUR response with update field 2 or 3

evidence.quote: If an R2 shift occurs during execution of a DUR response, where the Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R2 shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.

requirements.text: The reliability of ballistic missile launch/impact information is expressed in terms of location accuracy associated with the J3.0C5 Square/Circle Switch, Axis Orientation, Area Major Axis 4, and Area Minor Axis 4 fields.

evidence.quote: The reliability of ballistic missile launch/impact information is expressed in terms of location accuracy associated with the J3.0C5 Square/Circle Switch, Axis Orientation, Area Major Axis 4, and Area Minor Axis 4 fields.

requirements.text: The positional accuracy associated with these fields is defined as the area (dm2) within which there is a .95 probability that the point is located within the area reported in the Reference Point Message.

evidence.quote: The positional accuracy associated with these fields is defined as the area (dm2) within which there is a .95 probability that the point is located within the area reported in the Reference Point Message.

requirements.text: The ballistic missile covariance data related to the reported state vector shall be reported in accordance with the transmit/receive rules for the Space Track Message.

evidence.quote: The ballistic missile covariance data related to the reported state vector (consisting of the three position coordinates followed by the three velocity values) shall be reported in accordance with the transmit/receive rules for the Space Track Message.

requirements.text: Full covariance requires the transmitter to perform an encoding process of the full covariance matrix P into the J3.6C1, J3.6C2, J3.6C3, and J3.6C4 words.
requirements.conditions: Full covariance is reported

evidence.quote: Full covariance requires the transmitter to perform an encoding process of the full covariance matrix P into the J3.6C1, J3.6C2, J3.6C3, and J3.6C4 words.

requirements.text: Partial covariance requires the transmitter to perform two separate encoding processes: (1) The spatial covariance information is encoded into the J3.6C1 word; (2) the velocity information is separately encoded into the J3.6C5 word.
requirements.conditions: Partial covariance is reported

evidence.quote: Partial covariance requires the transmitter to perform two separate encoding processes: (1) The spatial covariance information is encoded into the J3.6C1 word; (2) the velocity information is separately encoded into the J3.6C5 word.

requirements.text: The algorithm used to derive ballistic missile TQ uses positional variance, velocity variance, and a scaling factor Delta t.

evidence.quote: The algorithm used to derive ballistic missile TQ is as follows: ... where sigma^2 pi(t) represents the positional variance ... sigma^2 vi(t) represents the velocity variance ... and (Delta t)^2 is a factor

requirements.text: Ballistic missile tracks are not extrapolated to time of transmission.

evidence.quote: Ballistic missile tracks are not extrapolated to time of transmission.

requirements.text: A JU holding 'Tracking' data may assume R2 with a TQ of 11 if a JU is reporting 'Lost Track' data with a TQ of 15 (regardless of the time tag on the remote track).
requirements.conditions: Remote JU reporting Lost Track with TQ 15 AND Local JU holding Tracking data

evidence.quote: i.e., if a JU is reporting "Lost Track" data with a TQ of 15, a JU holding "Tracking" data may assume R2 with a TQ of 11 (regardless of the time tag on the remote track).

requirements.text: Each system should have the capability to automatically purge those tracks after a specific time interval if no J7.0 Drop Track Report is received and no further updates are received.
requirements.conditions: No J7.0 Drop Track Report received AND no further updates received

evidence.quote: Each system should have the capability to automatically purge those tracks after a specific time interval.

requirements.text: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

requirements.text: Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data included in the J3.6 Space Track message.

evidence.quote: e. Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data included in the J3.6 Space Track message.

evidence.quote: Partial covariance requires the transmitter to perform two separate encoding processes: (1) The spatial covariance information is encoded into the J3.6C1 word; (2) the velocity information is separately encoded into the J3.6C5 word.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported ballistic missile identity cross-reference.

evidence.quote: Ballistic Missile identity is exchanged as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported OPTASK LINK definition requirement.

evidence.quote: Operational Commander defined values within the Space Specific Type field are defined at initialization via the OPTASK LINK.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported TQ field meaning (part 1).

evidence.quote: It is a numerical value of 0 through 15 indicating different degrees of reliability of the kinematic data.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported TQ field meaning (part 2).

evidence.quote: A value of 0 indicates a nonreal-time report and the values 1 through 15 indicate degrees of reliability with 15 being the most reliable.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only addition describing TQ algorithm components; retained as unresolved reference.

evidence.quote: The algorithm used to derive ballistic missile TQ is as follows: ... where sigma^2 pi(t) represents the positional variance ... sigma^2 vi(t) represents the velocity variance ... and (Delta t)^2 is a factor

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported Δt OPTASK LINK variable requirement.

evidence.quote: The variable Delta t is an arbitrary scaling factor expressed in units of seconds and is specified as an OPTASK LINK variable.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported Δt default value requirement.

evidence.quote: The default value of Delta t is 6 (0-24,1) seconds.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported lost track definition (part 1).

evidence.quote: A ballistic missile track is considered lost when the JU with R2 does not receive any local sensor data since the last transmitted update, or the JU determines that the track is lost by other system criteria.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported lost track reporting action (part 2).

evidence.quote: Subsequent reports on the ballistic missile track will include data held at the time of last sensor contact, and the Lost Track Indicator field will be set to value 1, Lost Track.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported no-extrapolation restriction.

evidence.quote: Ballistic missile track data will not be extrapolated except as specified in accordance with paragraph 4.4.6.13.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only addition specifying no extrapolation to time of transmission; retained as unresolved reference.

evidence.quote: Ballistic missile tracks are not extrapolated to time of transmission.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported time tagging requirement (part 1).

evidence.quote: All ballistic missile tracks will be time tagged to the integer second nearest to the measurement time

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported extrapolation/interpolation requirement (part 2).

evidence.quote: and all position, velocity, and covariance data shall be extrapolated or interpolated to the referenced time.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported timing accuracy requirement (part 1).

evidence.quote: The time accuracy of the extrapolation or interpolation shall be at the limit of system performance with an intent to achieve an accuracy of 0.3 milliseconds or less.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported no-truncation requirement (part 2).

evidence.quote: Truncation of time without extrapolation or interpolation is not acceptable.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported future-time acceptance preparation requirement.

evidence.quote: Systems must be prepared to accept data that may have time fields set to future values.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported nonreal-time TQ identification requirement.

evidence.quote: A ballistic missile track report is identified as a nonreal-time report with TQ field set to value 0, Non-real Time Track.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported first reporter R2 rule.

evidence.quote: a. The first JU to report the ballistic missile track has R2 on that track.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported R2 transmission gate.

evidence.quote: b. A JU transmits a track report for a ballistic missile only when it has R2 for that track.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported nonreal-time-to-real-time R2 relinquishment.

evidence.quote: A JU with R2 for a nonreal-time ballistic missile track will relinquish R2 upon receiving a remote real-time track report for that track.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported TQ superiority R2 assumption.

evidence.quote: c. A JU assumes R2 on a ballistic missile track if its local TQ at or before the time of the remote track time tag exceeds the received TQ by 1 or more.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported lost-track TQ reduction rule.

evidence.quote: d. A JU reporting a ballistic missile track with the Lost Track Indicator field set to value 1, Lost Track, is assumed to have a TQ of 5 (1-15,1) less than that being reported

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only addition detailing specific TQ assumption example; retained as unresolved reference.

evidence.quote: i.e., if a JU is reporting "Lost Track" data with a TQ of 15, a JU holding "Tracking" data may assume R2 with a TQ of 11 (regardless of the time tag on the remote track).

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported 25-second no-remote-report R2 rule (part 1).

evidence.quote: e. A JU assumes R2 if it has not received a remote report on a locally held track for 25 seconds.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported 25-second no-remote-report R2 rule condition (part 2).

evidence.quote: This rule only applies when the last remote report was received with Lost Track Indicator set to value 0, Tracking.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported drop-report R2 assumption rule.

evidence.quote: f. A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R2 at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported local nonreal-time update R2 rule (part 1).

evidence.quote: g. A JU without R2 for a nonreal-time track, i.e., TQ field set to value 0, shall assume R2 for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported local nonreal-time update R2 rule (part 2).

evidence.quote: A JU reporting a nonreal-time track has R2 regardless of the time value in the track report.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported local nonreal-time update R2 rule (part 3).

evidence.quote: The time value in a nonreal-time report is not a criterion for an R2 shift.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported higher remote TQ relinquishment.

evidence.quote: h. A JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported R2 retention-until-rule-or-drop requirement.

evidence.quote: i. A JU with R2 on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported equal-TQ Source TN tie-breaker.

evidence.quote: j. After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported missile-track/launch-point R2 independence (part 1).

evidence.quote: k. A unit assuming R2 for a ballistic missile track need not assume R2 for the associated launch point.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported missile-track/launch-point R2 independence (part 2).

evidence.quote: The unit no longer holding R2 on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported non-kinematic identity-type difference resolution.

evidence.quote: Detection and resolution of Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Environment/Category differences are resolved by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported prohibition on position/velocity Difference Reports.

evidence.quote: Differences in ballistic missile position or velocity recognized by a JU are not resolved through conflict processing and shall not generate a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 1, Difference Report.

candidate_decisions.reason: Supported ballistic missile Drop Track Report transmission requirement.

evidence.quote: The J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a ballistic missile track for which it currently has R2, except when a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R2 to another JU.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only addition detailing purge capability; mapped to unresolved no-drop-report rule (R067) and unresolved purge capability reference (R079).

evidence.quote: Each system should have the capability to automatically purge those tracks after a specific time interval.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only addition referencing general surveillance transmission rule; retained as unresolved reference.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

candidate_decisions.reason: C-only addition listing surveillance data types; retained as unresolved reference.

evidence.quote: e. Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data included in the J3.6 Space Track message.
