scope.goal: Publish Electronic Warfare Surveillance Products (LOBs, Fixes, AOPs) on the Link 16 Surveillance Network PG using J3.7 messages, managing reporting responsibility, correlation, and termination.
scope.start_boundary: When an EW-capable C2 JU determines EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG.
scope.success_boundary: When EW products are transmitted with required J3.7 word sequences/fields, managed under reporting responsibility rules, and terminated/purged per standard.
in_scope: Determination of EW detection eligibility
Transmission of LOBs, Fixes, and AOPs via J3.7
Amplification via J6.0
Word sequence requirements and descriptors (FIX BRG)
Track Number (TN) assignment and continuity rules
Reporting Responsibility (R2) retention and prohibitions
Time data encoding
Response to Data Update Requests (J7.1)
EW Association (J7.7) and Correlation (J7.2) rules
Termination (J7.0) and Purging
Bearing Origin reporting
Alert Indicators (EMG/FT) for EW products
Filtering rules specific to EW products
out_of_scope: Non-C2 JU transmission on Surveillance NPG
Internal sensor processing algorithms
Detailed J14.0/J14.2 parametric procedures beyond cited exceptions
Network PG timing/access rules defined in unreferenced paragraph 4.2.3.10.5

evidence.quote: EW-capable C² JUs and JUs capable of generating and managing track numbers shall determine which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG.
LOBs, fixes, and AOPs are reported via the J3.7 EW Product Information message on the Surveillance Network PG.
The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility.

requirements.text: An EW-capable C2 JU shall determine which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG, and may do so manually or through automatic association with predetermined reporting criteria.

evidence.quote: EW-capable C² JUs and JUs capable of generating and managing track numbers shall determine which EW detections are eligible for transmission on the Surveillance Network PG. This may be done either manually or through automatic association with predetermined reporting criteria.

requirements.text: A C2 JU participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

requirements.text: The C2 JU may amplify LOBs, fixes, and AOPs by the J6.0 Amplification message on the Surveillance Network PG.

evidence.quote: LOBs, fixes, and AOPs may be amplified by the J6.0 Amplification message on the Surveillance Network PG.

requirements.text: The word sequences used to describe EW reporting are the minimum required, and additional continuation words may be added to amplify EW reports if data are available.

evidence.quote: The word sequences presented to describe EW reporting are the minimum required. Additional continuation words may be added to these word sequences to amplify EW reports if data are available.

requirements.text: Transmit LOBs derived from ES, jam strobes/EA, or RDF equipment using J3.7 and set FIX BRG as follows: value 2 for bearing type not specified; value 3 for an ES-source bearing other than RDF; value 4 for an EA jam strobe; value 5 for an RDF bearing with no associated parametric data; and value 7 when the signal direction of arrival is unknown.

evidence.quote: Value 2 - Bearing, Type Not Specified - An LOB for which the reporting JU is unable to specify the bearing as ES, EA, or RDF.
Value 3 - Bearing, ES - An LOB of an intercept obtained from ES sources other than RDF.
Value 4 - Bearing, EA - An LOB specifying a jam strobe.
Value 5 - Bearing, Radio Direction Finding - An LOB of an intercept obtained from RDF sources with no associated parametric data.
Value 7 - Bearing, Unknown - The direction of arrival of the signal is unknown.

requirements.text: LOB reports shall include the time of the intercept in the J3.7I word.

evidence.quote: LOB reports include the time of the intercept in the J3.7I word.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall report elevation angles in an LOB only if it is reporting its PPLI.

evidence.quote: Elevation angles shall only be reported by units who are reporting their PPLI.

requirements.text: If the 2-sigma bearing accuracy (95% probability) of the passive system is available, it should be included in the J3.7C1 word to allow receiving systems to generate AOPs.
requirements.conditions: {"accuracy_available":true}

evidence.quote: If the 2 sigma bearing accuracy (95% probability) of the passive system is available, it should be included in the J3.7C1 word to allow receiving systems to generate AOPs.

requirements.text: If an LOB results from an evaluated ES intercept with FIX BRG set to value 3, the C2 JU should set the Emitter Number and Emitter Confidence fields.
requirements.conditions: {"fix_or_bearing_descriptor":3}

evidence.quote: If an LOB results from an evaluated ES intercept (FIX BRG field set to value 3), the Emitter Number and the Emitter Confidence fields should be set.

requirements.text: When reporting an EW fix resulting from the crossing of two or more LOBs, the C2 JU shall use a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum and set FIX BRG to value 0 in J3.7I.
requirements.conditions: {"product_type":"EW fix"}

evidence.quote: An EW fix results from the crossing of two or more LOBs and is reported using a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum with FIX BRG field set to value 0 in the J3.7I word.

requirements.text: When reporting an EW fix, the C2 JU shall specify the fix location by the latitude and longitude fields in the J3.7C2 word.
requirements.conditions: {"product_type":"EW fix"}

evidence.quote: The location of the fix is specified by the latitude and longitude fields in the J3.7C2 word.

requirements.text: An EW fix may be derived automatically or manually.

evidence.quote: An EW fix may be derived either automatically or manually.

requirements.text: An EW fix resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs, and the new TN shall be used for all subsequent fix updates.
requirements.conditions: {"origin":"previously reported LOBs"}

evidence.quote: An EW fix resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs. The new TN shall be used for all subsequent updates of the fix.

requirements.text: When an AOP is changed to a fix, the C2 JU shall use the TN of the previously reported AOP for the new fix.
requirements.conditions: {"transition":"AOP to fix"}

evidence.quote: However, when an AOP is changed to a fix, the TN of the previously reported AOP shall be used for the new fix.

requirements.text: A C2 JU may report an AOP based on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of those sources.

evidence.quote: A C2 JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.

requirements.text: An AOP is the area in which there is a 95% probability (2 sigma) of a particular emitter being located.
requirements.conditions: {"product_type":"AOP"}

evidence.quote: An AOP is defined as that area in which there is a 95% probability (2 sigma) of a particular emitter being located.

requirements.text: When reporting an AOP, the C2 JU shall use a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum and transmit J3.7I with FIX BRG set to value 1.
requirements.conditions: {"product_type":"AOP"}

evidence.quote: An AOP is reported using a J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence as a minimum. The J3.7I word shall be transmitted with FIX BRG field set to value 1.
When defining EW AOPs (refer to paragraph 4.4.7.1.3) the J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence, as a minimum, is used.

requirements.text: The J3.7I word for an AOP shall contain the time the AOP was valid.
requirements.conditions: {"product_type":"AOP"}

evidence.quote: The J3.7I word contains the time the AOP was valid

requirements.text: The J3.7C2 word for an AOP shall define the AOP using the procedures and fields in paragraph 4.4.3.1.2b.
requirements.conditions: {"product_type":"AOP"}

evidence.quote: and the J3.7C2 word defines the AOP. Refer to paragraph 4.4.3.1.2b for the procedures and the fields used to describe AOPs with the J3.7 message.

requirements.text: An AOP resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs.
requirements.conditions: {"origin":"previously reported LOBs"}

evidence.quote: An AOP resulting from previously reported LOBs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the LOBs.

requirements.text: An AOP resulting from two or more previously reported fixes of differing TNs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the fixes.
requirements.conditions: {"origin":"two or more fixes with differing TNs"}

evidence.quote: An AOP resulting from two or more previously reported fixes of differing TNs shall be assigned a new TN, not one of the TNs assigned to the fixes.

requirements.text: The new TN assigned to an AOP shall be used for all subsequent updates of the AOP.
requirements.conditions: {"product_type":"AOP"}

evidence.quote: The new TN shall be used for all subsequent updates of the AOP.

requirements.text: When a fix is changed to an AOP, the C2 JU shall use the TN of the previously reported fix for the new AOP.
requirements.conditions: {"transition":"fix to AOP"}

evidence.quote: However, when a fix is changed to an AOP, the TN of the previously reported fix shall be used for the new AOP.

requirements.text: The Platform Evaluation Confidence field of J3.7C1 shall report the degree of confidence that the emitter's platform is as reported in the Environment/Category and/or Platform fields.

evidence.quote: The Platform Evaluation Confidence field of the J3.7C1 word reports the degree of confidence that the emitter's platform is as reported in the Environment/Category and/or Platform fields.

requirements.text: The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility, and it is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report.

evidence.quote: The unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report always retains reporting responsibility. It is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report.

requirements.text: When initiating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report, the C2 JU shall assign a TN not known to be in use on the interface, even if the report may concern the same emitter being reported in another J3.7 report by another unit.

evidence.quote: Each unit initiating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report shall assign a TN not known to be in use on the interface even if it is believed that such a report may concern the same emitter currently being reported in another J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report by another unit.

requirements.text: When originating a J3.7 report on a fix, AOP, or LOB currently reported by the same unit or received from another unit in a J14.0 message, the C2 JU shall assign the same TN Reference in J3.7 as contained in the J14.0 message.
requirements.conditions: {"fix_aop_or_lob_received_in_j14_0":true}

evidence.quote: The exception is a unit originating a J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report on a Fix, AOP, or LOB currently reported by the same unit or received from another unit in a J14.0 message shall assign the same TN, Reference in the J3.7 message as contained in the J14.0 message.

requirements.text: The Source TN of the C2 JU's J3.7 messages shall be the Source TN of the unit transmitting the J3.7 message.

evidence.quote: The Source TN of these J3.7 messages shall be the Source TN of the unit transmitting the J3.7 message.

requirements.text: J3.7 messages transmitted by non-R2 JUs with the Response Indicator set to value 1 shall not affect reporting responsibility.
requirements.conditions: {"sender":"non-R2 JU","response_indicator":1}

evidence.quote: J3.7 messages transmitted by nonR2 JUs with the Response Indicator set to value 1 shall not affect reporting responsibility.

requirements.text: Upon receipt of an applicable J7.1 request, if the J7.1 Addressee TN is 00177, JUs with R2 shall transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by Request Indicator value 1.
requirements.conditions: {"j7_1_addressee_tn":"00177"}

evidence.quote: If the J7.1 Addressee TN is set to value 00177, JUs with R2 transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by the Request Indicator set to value 1.

requirements.text: When a J7.1 request is addressed to the C2 JU's own TN, the C2 JU shall transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by the Request Indicators, with the J3.7 Response Indicator set to value 1.
requirements.conditions: {"j7_1_addressee_tn":"own JU"}

evidence.quote: If the J7.1 Addressee TN is set to own JU, transmit all J3.7 EW data on the TN or as specified by the Request Indicators, with the J3.7 Response Indicator set to value 1.

requirements.text: EW association shall be reported using the J7.7 message.

evidence.quote: EW association shall be reported using the J7.7 message.

requirements.text: The C2 JU may use J7.2 to correlate EW AOPs with surveillance tracks, but shall not use J7.2 to correlate EW LOBs and fixes with surveillance tracks.

evidence.quote: The J7.2 message may be used to correlate EW AOPs with surveillance tracks, but shall not be used to correlate EW LOBs and fixes with surveillance tracks.

requirements.text: If an EW AOP can be correlated with a surveillance track, the C2 JU may transmit a J7.2 correlation message with Retained TN set to the surveillance track TN and Dropped TN set to the EW AOP TN.
requirements.conditions: {"aop_correlates_with_surveillance_track":true}

evidence.quote: If the EW AOP can be correlated with a surveillance track, a J7.2 correlation message may be transmitted with the Retained TN set to the TN of the track and the Dropped TN set to the TN of the EW AOP.

requirements.text: When the C2 JU drops or ceases reporting EW information that it has been reporting on the interface, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, and it shall not transmit J7.0 (ACT = 0) on remote reports.

evidence.quote: When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information, that it has been reporting on the interface, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message. The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted on remote reports.

requirements.text: When the EW LOB origin is the C2 JU's own unit, the C2 JU shall set Bearing Origin to value 0, set Origin TN to its own assigned TN, and transmit J3.7C2 containing the latitude and longitude of the bearing origin.
requirements.conditions: {"bearing_origin":"own unit"}

evidence.quote: Own Unit: The Bearing Origin field shall be set to value 0; the Origin TN field shall be set to own unit's assigned TN; and the J3.7C2 word shall be transmitted containing the latitude and longitude of the bearing origin.

requirements.text: When the EW LOB origin is another existing IU, track, or point, the C2 JU shall set Bearing Origin to value 0, set Origin TN to the TN of the designated IU, track, or point, and transmit J3.7C2 containing the latitude and longitude of the bearing origin.
requirements.conditions: {"bearing_origin":"another existing IU, track, or point"}

evidence.quote: Another existing IU, track, or point: The Bearing Origin field shall be set to value 0; the Origin TN field shall be set to the TN of the designated IU, track, or point; and the J3.7C2 word shall be transmitted containing the latitude and longitude of the bearing origin.

requirements.text: When the EW LOB origin is a designated position, the C2 JU shall set Bearing Origin to value 1, set Origin TN to value 0, and transmit J3.7C2 containing the latitude and longitude of the designated bearing origin.

target.name: Publish Subsurface Surveillance and Acoustic Contact Reports

scope.goal: Publish Subsurface Surveillance and Acoustic Contact Reports
scope.start_boundary: When the C2 JU has tactically significant information derived from ASW sensors, including established subsurface tracks, bearings/ranges, DATUMs, inactive subsurface IUs, or ASW points/lines/areas eligible for reporting.
scope.success_boundary: The C2 JU publishes the applicable subsurface surveillance or acoustic contact report with required source, position/depth, time, identity, bearing/range, DATUM, ASW point, association, reporting-responsibility, termination, or purging data according to the specified rules.
in_scope: J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track reports
J5.4 Acoustic Bearing/Range reports
J3.0 ASW points, lines, and areas supporting subsurface surveillance
DATUM reporting when contact is lost
Reporting inactive subsurface interface units
Subsurface track association and reporting responsibility
Termination and purging of subsurface track data
out_of_scope: Air, Surface (Maritime), Land (Ground), Space, Ballistic Missile, or Electronic Warfare surveillance reporting except where their rules are explicitly invoked
NonC2 JU behavior on the Surveillance NPG
Detailed J3.4/J5.4/J3.0 word bit maps and Section 5 redundancy rules
IFF/SIF and track quality processing for subsurface tracks where the source states they are not applicable

evidence.quote: The specific message used to report Subsurface surveillance tracks is the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.

The J3.0, J3.4, and J5.4 messages are used to exchange tactically significant information that has been derived from ASW sensors. Within the Subsurface surveillance function these messages are used to report bearings, ranges, and tracks.
C² JUs that report subsurface tracks shall have the capability to report a track as a DATUM when contact is lost.

When a JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and the JU also holds local data on the IU, it shall assume R2 by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN.
The following subparagraphs describe the termination of Subsurface tracks.

requirements.text: A C2 JU participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

evidence.quote: C2 JUs participating in the exchange of J3 Surveillance messages shall transmit surveillance information in Network PGs as defined in paragraph 4.2.3.10.5.

requirements.text: When reporting Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance tracks, the C2 JU shall use the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.

evidence.quote: The specific message used to report Subsurface surveillance tracks is the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.

requirements.text: Reporting of Subsurface surveillance track information on the interface shall ensure that the information is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.

evidence.quote: a.  The information on the track is as complete, accurate, and timely as possible.

requirements.text: Reporting of Subsurface surveillance track information on the interface shall follow the proper rules for reporting a track.

evidence.quote: b.  The proper rules for reporting a track are followed.

requirements.text: A C2 JU reporting a Subsurface track shall provide the source of track data as the Source TN.

evidence.quote: a.  The source of track data shall be provided (Source TN).

requirements.text: All Subsurface surveillance data shall be time tagged.

evidence.quote: c.  All data shall be time tagged.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report acoustic bearings from the detecting sensor origin; the source frequency is not required to report acoustic information.

evidence.quote: The source frequency is not required to report acoustic information. Bearings shall be reported from the detecting sensor origin.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall set the J5.4E0 Latitude and Longitude fields to the position of the acoustic bearing origin.

evidence.quote: a.  The J5.4E0 Latitude and Longitude fields shall be set to the position of the acoustic bearing origin.

requirements.text: If the detecting sensor is integral to the reporting JU, the C2 JU shall place the reporting JU's TN in the J5.4C2 Origin TN field; a towed array is considered integral to the ship.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"detecting sensor is integral to the reporting JU"}]

evidence.quote: If the detecting sensor is integral to the reporting JU, the J5.4C2 Origin TN field shall contain the TN of the reporting JU.  A towed array is considered integral to the ship.

requirements.text: If the detecting sensor is integral to another reported unit, track, or point, the C2 JU shall place that detecting unit's, track's, or point's TN in the Origin TN field.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"detecting sensor is integral to another unit, track, or point being reported"}]

evidence.quote: If the detecting sensor is integral to another unit, track, or point (e.g., non-IU, sonobuoy) being reported, the Origin TN field shall contain the TN of the detecting unit, track, or point.

requirements.text: If the detecting sensor is neither integral to the reporting JU nor to another reported unit, track, or point, the C2 JU shall set the Origin TN field to zero, No Statement.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"detecting sensor is not integral to reporting JU or another reported unit, track, or point"}]

evidence.quote: Otherwise, the Origin TN field shall be set to value zero (No Statement) to indicate the detecting sensor is neither integral to the reporting JU nor to another reported unit, track, or point (e.g., unreported sonobuoy).

requirements.text: The position of a bearing origin need not be the same as the position of Origin TN.

evidence.quote: The position of a bearing origin need not be the same as the position of Origin TN.

requirements.text: When a bearing is detected by a towed array, the C2 JU shall report the origin as the actual position based on the length of the array.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"bearing detected by a towed array"}]

evidence.quote: The origin of a bearing detected by a towed array shall be reported as the actual position based on the length of the array.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall discard a J5.4 message with BRT set to value 0 or 3 if the Range field is received as No Statement.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"received BRT = 0 or 3 and Range = No Statement"}]

evidence.quote: JUs shall discard a message with BRT set to value 0 or 3 if the Range field is received as No Statement.

requirements.text: If both activation and deactivation times are not received, the C2 JU shall use a default period of 2 hours for NOTACK Areas and 155 minutes for FWDAs.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"both times are not received for NOTACK Area or FWDA"}]

evidence.quote: If both times are not received, the default period for NOTACK Areas is 2 hours and for FWDAs is 155 minutes.

requirements.text: For Sonobuoy Position, the C2 JU shall report deactivation time to specify deployed-asset expiration or activation time to specify future deployment, and shall report sonobuoy RF channel number, depth indicator and transducer depth when optional, sonobuoy type, and holding contact status as appropriate.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"reporting Sonobuoy Position"}]

evidence.quote: For Sonobuoy Position and Sonobuoy Pattern Reference Position, time of deactivation will be reported to specify the time of expiration of deployed assets, or time of activation will be reported to specify the time for the deployment of future assets. Additionally, the sonobuoy RF channel number, depth indicator and transducer depth (optional), sonobuoy type, and holding contact status will be reported as appropriate for a sonobuoy position.

requirements.text: For Sonobuoy Pattern Reference Position, the C2 JU shall report pattern type, number of sonobuoys, sonobuoy spacing, sonobuoy row spacing, pattern radius, and/or bearing as necessary.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"reporting Sonobuoy Pattern Reference Position"}]

evidence.quote: For Sonobuoy Pattern Reference position, the pattern type, number of sonobuoys, sonobuoy spacing, sonobuoy row spacing, pattern radius, and/or bearing may be reported as necessary.

requirements.text: A C2 JU that reports Subsurface tracks shall have the capability to report a track as a DATUM when contact is lost.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"contact is lost on a subsurface track"}]

evidence.quote: C² JUs that report subsurface tracks shall have the capability to report a track as a DATUM when contact is lost.

requirements.text: The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.

evidence.quote: a.  The decision to report a DATUM shall be an operator function.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report a DATUM in a J3.4 message with the same Reference TN as the track for which contact was lost.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"reporting a DATUM"}]

evidence.quote: b.  The DATUM shall be reported in a J3.4 message with the same Reference TN as the track for which contact has been lost

requirements.text: For a DATUM, the C2 JU shall report latitude, longitude, 15 Meters Depth, and Depth Contact as the last known position, course and speed as the last calculated values, and the sensor that held contact.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"reporting a DATUM"}]

evidence.quote:
(4)  Latitude, Longitude, 15 Meters Depth, and Depth Contact: Last known position. 
 
(5)  Course and Speed:  Last calculated course and speed. 
 
(6)  Sensor:  The sensor that held contact.

requirements.text: For a DATUM, all fields other than the specified DATUM fields shall remain the same as values held before contact was lost unless changed by operator action.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"reporting a DATUM"}]

evidence.quote: (7)  All other fields:  Same as values held before contact was lost unless changed by operator action.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report DATUM Error in the J3.4 if calculated, and shall use the J3.4 DATUM Error field only when Data Report Type equals 4.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"DATUM Error is calculated and DRT = 4"}]

evidence.quote: DATUM Error shall be reported in the J3.4 if calculated.  The J3.4 DATUM Error field is used only when DRT = 4.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall update DATUMs in accordance with J3.4 Transmit Rules; all data except DATUM Error shall remain the same as the initial DATUM report unless changed by operator action.

evidence.quote: DATUMs shall be updated in accordance with the J3.4 Transmit Rules. However, all data except DATUM Error shall remain the same as reported in the initial DATUM report, unless changed by operator action.

requirements.text: A DATUM shall only be dropped or purged by operator action.

evidence.quote: f.  A DATUM shall only be dropped or purged by operator action.

requirements.text: If contact is regained, the C2 JU shall report a J3.4 with Data Report Type set to 0, 1, or 2 using the same TN as the DATUM or a new TN depending on operator action.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"contact is regained after DATUM"}]

evidence.quote: If contact is regained, a J3.4 with DRT set to value 0, 1 or 2 shall be reported with the same TN as the DATUM, or a new TN depending on operator action.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall not apply Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) track correlation procedures to Subsurface tracks.

evidence.quote: the correlation procedures which are specified for Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) tracks are not applied to Subsurface tracks.

requirements.text: Manual correlation of Subsurface surveillance data is an operator function.

evidence.quote: Instead, it is the function of the operator to perform manual correlation of Subsurface surveillance data.

requirements.text: When it is determined that two TNs are being used to report information for the same Subsurface target, the C2 JU shall use the J7.7 Track Association message to support a complete compilation of the subsurface situation.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"two TNs report information for the same subsurface target"}]

evidence.quote: In order to provide for a complete compilation of the subsurface situation, the J7.7 Track Association message is used whenever it is determined that two Track Numbers (TNs) are being used to report information for the same target.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report geodetic latitude and longitude for each Subsurface surveillance track in the J3.4 message.

evidence.quote: The geodetic latitude and longitude for each Subsurface surveillance track shall be reported in the J3.4 message.

requirements.text: Subsurface surveillance reporting shall include the capability for specifying depth when available.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"depth is available"}]

evidence.quote: In addition, Subsurface surveillance reporting shall include the capability for specifying depth when available.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall exchange track identity using the Identity field, and may report Platform and Platform Activity in the J3.4I message to amplify identity.

evidence.quote: Track identity, as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1, is exchanged using the Identity field.  Platform and Platform Activity may also be reported in the J3.4I message to further amplify the identity of the reported track in accordance with paragraph 4.4.2.1.3.

requirements.text: The C2 JU shall report Discrete Identifier Codes (Special) in the J7.5 message in accordance with paragraph 4.7.6.5.

evidence.quote: Discrete Identifier Codes (Special) shall be reported in the J7.5 message in accordance with paragraph 4.7.6.5.

requirements.text: Track quality is not applicable to Subsurface surveillance.

evidence.quote: Track quality is not applicable to Subsurface surveillance (See paragraph 4.4.5.10.).

requirements.text: The first JU to report a Subsurface contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number.

evidence.quote: a.  The first JU to report a contact assumes reporting responsibility for that Track Number.

requirements.text: Any other JU may report what it believes to be the same Subsurface contact using a different TN.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"JU believes it has the same contact as another TN"}]

evidence.quote: b.  Any other JU may report what it believes to be the same contact using a different TN.

requirements.text: When a JU reports the same suspected contact under a different TN, it shall report only locally derived data in J3.4 and shall not include data derived solely from remote data received from other IUs reporting the same contact.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"reporting same suspected contact with different TN"}]

evidence.quote: When this is done, only locally derived data shall be reported in the J3.4 message, i.e., the J3.4 messages shall not contain data derived only by the reception of remote data from other IU(s) reporting the same contact.

requirements.text: When a C2 JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active and also holds local data on the IU, it shall assume R2 by reporting a J3.4 message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"Subsurface IU is inactive and local data is held"}]

evidence.quote: When a JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and the JU also holds local data on the IU, it shall assume R2 by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN.

requirements.text: No JU shall report an inactive Subsurface IU using a reference TN other than the inactive IU address.

evidence.quote: No other JU shall report the inactive IU using other than the inactive IU address as the reference TN.

requirements.text: If the inactive Subsurface IU returns as an Active IU, the JU holding R2 shall cease reporting the IU and shall not transmit a J7.0 Drop Track message.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"inactive subsurface IU returns Active"}]

evidence.quote: Should the inactive IU return to the interface as an Active IU, the JU holding R2 shall cease reporting the IU, but a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.

requirements.text: If a TN has previously been reported on the Subsurface IU using a TN other than the IU's address, the J7.2 message may be used to resolve the dual designation to the IU's address.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"prior TN differs from inactive IU address"}]

evidence.quote: If a TN has been previously reported on the IU, using other than the IU's address, the J7.2 message may be used to resolve the dual designation to the IU's address.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall resolve detected Subsurface information differences by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.

evidence.quote: Differences are resolved by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall transmit a J7.0 Drop Track Report when it ceases reporting a Subsurface track, except when that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address previously used as the reference TN.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"JU ceases reporting a subsurface track"}]

evidence.quote: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track except when that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN.

requirements.text: For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, the C2 JU shall transmit a J7.0 Drop Track message at time of deactivation.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"NOTACK area, Moving Haven, or FWDA is deactivated"}]

evidence.quote: For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall be transmitted at time of deactivation.

requirements.text: A C2 JU shall have the capability to automatically purge remote Subsurface tracks with Data Report Type 0 through 3 after a system-selected time interval that considers the irregular reporting of Subsurface surveillance tracks.

evidence.quote: Each system will have the capability to automatically purge those tracks (DRT = 0-3) after a specific time interval.  The time interval is a system-selected parameter and should consider the irregular reporting of Subsurface surveillance tracks.

requirements.text: When automatically purging a remote Subsurface track, the C2 JU shall not transmit a J7.0 Drop Track message.
requirements.conditions: [{"condition":"remote subsurface track is automatically purged"}]

evidence.quote: Under this condition a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.

requirements.text: DATUMs with Data Report Type 4 shall not be purged automatically.

evidence.quote: DATUMS (DRT = 4) shall not be purged automatically.

requirements.text: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.

evidence.quote: e.  Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.

evidence.quote: The J7.1 message consists of the J7.1I Data Update Request initial word and J7.1C1 Data Update Request Additional Addresses continuation word and is used to request:
a. Data on a specific TN by setting the Action, Data Update Request field to value 1,
b. Data by specific request indicator values by setting the Action, Data Update Request field to value 0, or
c. Space track state vector or covariance data by setting the Action, Data Update Request field to value 2.
the requesting JU initiates the J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) message with the specific TN in the Reference TN field and addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal.

The JU with R2 shall respond with surveillance information upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN. This JU shall transmit all data held in the appropriate J3 message, except that covariance data will not be included on ballistic missile tracks.

A JU with R2 for a line or area shall 
transmit the entire line or area upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) for any TN 
used to define the line or area.

Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU(s) that 
have originated surveillance amplification data on the track shall respond 
with the J6.0 Amplification message containing all available data.

Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU controlling 
the TN shall transmit the appropriate J10 Weapons Coordination and Management 
messages and J13 Platform and System Status messages

All C2 JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN shall 
transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all 
engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message 
to report their own status.

If the Reference TN is being reported in a J3.7 message, the reporting JU 
shall transmit all data held in a J3.7 message.

Also, if the request is 
collectively addressed, any JU which has initiated an EW evaluation or 
association on the Reference TN in a J14.2 message shall transmit a J14.2 
message with EW Action Value field set to values 7, 8, or 9 addressed to the 
requesting unit with the R/C field set to value 1.

If the request is specifically addressed, the addressee shall transmit all locally held EW evaluations and associations in the J14.2 message with EW Action Value field set to values 7, 8, or 9 addressed to the requesting unit with R/C field set to value 1.

The C2 JU with R2 for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track 
message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action 
field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.

NonR2 JUs shall not respond to a J7.1 (ACT = 2) Ballistic Missile Update 
Request.

If an R2 shift occurs during execution of a DUR response, where the 
Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R2 
shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.

The J7.1 (ACT = 0) Data Update Request by Request Indicator message has the 
capability to request information by request indicator values.  The message 
is addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 
00177 octal.

When a JU responds with a J3.0, J3.7 and/or a J6.0 Amplification message, the 
Response Indicator field in these messages shall be set to value 1.

If a JU without R2 desires that a specific point, line, or area be 
transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update, it should 
transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.

Responses to Data Update Requests for multi-point areas or multi-segmented lines (defined by more than one J3.0 message) shall be transmitted with the PER IND set to value 0 and the Response Indicator set to value 1.

In the absence of textual clarification the J7.3 message is used in 
conjunction with voice communications.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D003 matches the source requirement for addressing capabilities.

evidence.quote:
The J7.3 message can be addressed to 
one, multiple, or all IUs.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D004 matches the source requirement for single recipient addressing.

evidence.quote:
When it is addressed to one JU, the J7.3I Pointer 
initial word contains the specific address.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D005 matches the source requirement for multiple recipient addressing.

evidence.quote:
When it is addressed to multiple 
JUs, the J7.3I word contains one address and the J7.3C1 Pointer Additional 
Addresses continuation word can contain up to four additional addresses.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D006 matches the source requirement for accommodating more than five addresses.

evidence.quote: Multiple J7.3C1 words can be sent to accommodate more than five addresses.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D007 matches the source requirement for using J7.3C2/C3 for text.

evidence.quote:
The J7.3C2 and J7.3C3 words are used to provide amplifying textual 
information of up to twenty characters.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D008 matches the source requirement for collective addressing.

evidence.quote:
When a J7.3 message is addressed to 
all JUs, the J7.3I word contains the collective address.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D009 matches the source requirement for pointer action data element usage.

evidence.quote:
The J7.3 message 
can be used to specify one or more operator positions by function within a JU 
through the use of the pointer action data element.

candidate_decisions.reason: Candidate C:D010 focuses on the 'no TN assigned' aspect. While phrased as a negative constraint ('shall not assign'), the source text 'There is no TN assigned... therefore it must be displayed...' implies the operational consequence is the primary requirement. R011 captures the full source statement including the consequence (display/drop by local procedure), which subsumes the fact that no TN is assigned.

evidence.quote:
There is no TN assigned 
to the pointer
There is no TN assigned to the pointer; therefore, it must be displayed and dropped by local procedure.
